entries.name: The Orem
entries.source: THE OREM — Complete Compendium (English); author's note (12 Oct 2026)
entries.excerpt: The Orem is mostly the afterlife: the realm and the organization (the "Organization" of the dossiers) where the dead go. The sources call it humanity's only hope. It stands on Paradis, the planet and goddess of the first book. Its name is also read as "theorem

entries.name: Orpheus (Orfeo; Boman; Ver; L'Aldilà / The Beyond; Vescovo Onorario / Honorary Bishop; Santo Orfeo; Ptah; Dio Infinito dei Sogni / Infinite God of Dreams; The One Beyond; Holy Orpheus)
entries.excerpt: Orpheus (also Boman, Ver, Ptah, The Beyond, the Honorary Bishop, Holy Orpheus, Infinite God of Dreams) is a Demiurge-class entity: the artist's tulpa, a being inside the mind that reflects the artist's strengths. He sits on a non-existent throne at the centre

entries.name: The Beyonders ([REM-001](#/rem-001); Squadra dei Beyonders; TTF Phi-1)
entries.object_class: ESOTERIC / EKHI / ARCHON / CRITICAL, Level 6 Cosmic Top Secret (his, SCPs Ideas)
entries.excerpt: The Beyonders (TTF Phi-1) are a group of outerversal travellers stationed in the empty space between fantasy and actuality. Established by the Orem, they safeguard the fictional universes by eliminating or deleting sentient creatures that threaten continuity.

entries.name: The Beyonder (captain Edward Laurence / Edward Lawrence; Captain Nero; "admiral"; [REM-002](#/rem-002); formerly 001-1a)
entries.excerpt: The Beyonder (Edward Laurence, also written Edward Lawrence; Captain Nero; called "the admiral") is the captain of the Beyonders REM-001, a crew of outerversal travellers based in the blank space between fiction and reality. He is described as an Italian pirat

entries.name: First-mate K████ (Kuzan / Aokiji; formerly 001-1b)
entries.excerpt: Kuzan, better known as Aokiji, is the first-mate of the Beyonders' crew REM-001, ranked staff 1. He is 49 years old and 187 cm tall, from the One Piece universe. He is a former marine admiral and the Tenth Titanic Captain of the Blackbeard pirates.

entries.name: Second-mate K███ (King; formerly 001-1c)
entries.excerpt: King is the second-mate of the Beyonders' crew REM-001, ranked staff 1. He is 29 years old and 298 cm tall, from the One-Punch Man universe.

entries.name: Third-mate [REM-005](#/rem-005) (formerly 001-1d)
entries.excerpt: The third-mate of the Beyonders' crew REM-001. He was actively involved in the crew and was made third-mate by unanimous consent, then given his own item designation; his information is kept in his own file. No further details are given in the sources.

entries.name: Quartermaster K██████ (Kishibe; formerly 001-2a)
entries.excerpt: Kishibe is the quartermaster of the Beyonders' crew REM-001, ranked staff 2 (commanders with multiple tasks). He is in his 50s and 194 cm tall. He is a human who controls three devils.

entries.name: Master-at-arms M██████ N██████ (Machiko Noguchi; formerly 001-2b)
entries.excerpt: Machiko Noguchi is the master-at-arms of the Beyonders' crew REM-001, ranked staff 2. She is 29 years old and 157.5 cm tall, and is described as a human yautja.

entries.name: Helmsman Aggregor (formerly 001-2c)
entries.excerpt: Aggregor is the helmsman of the Beyonders' crew REM-001. He is an Osmosian. No further details are given.

entries.name: Gunner Lazuli (formerly 001-3a)
entries.excerpt: Lazuli is the gunner of the Beyonders' crew REM-001, ranked staff 3. She is in her 30s, 169 cm tall, and a humanoid android.

entries.name: Sniper Amélie ███████ (Widowmaker; formerly 001-3b)
entries.excerpt: Amélie, known as Widowmaker, is the sniper of the Beyonders' crew REM-001, ranked staff 3. She is 33 years old and 175 cm tall.

entries.name: Shipwright K█████ (Karnak; formerly 001-3c)
entries.excerpt: Karnak is the shipwright of the Beyonders' crew REM-001, ranked staff 3. His other details are listed as TBA.

entries.name: Lookout A██████ S████ (Aburame Shino; formerly 001-3d)
entries.excerpt: Aburame Shino is the lookout of the Beyonders' crew REM-001, ranked staff 3. His other details are listed as TBA.

entries.name: Rigger Z█████ (Zaheer; formerly 001-3e)
entries.excerpt: Zaheer is the rigger of the Beyonders' crew REM-001, ranked staff 3. His other details are listed as TBA.

entries.name: Scholar A███████ L███ (Angstrom Levy; formerly 001-3f)
entries.excerpt: Angstrom Levy is the scholar of the Beyonders' crew REM-001, ranked staff 3. His other details are listed as TBA.

entries.name: Ship ███████ O'Brian (Patrick O'Brian; also written [REM-015](#/rem-015); formerly 001-3g)
entries.excerpt: Patrick O'Brian is the ship of the Beyonders' crew REM-001: a living vessel. He is a human able to stretch his body to great lengths and contort himself into any position imaginable.

entries.name: Geisha M██ S███████ (Mai Shiranui; formerly 001-4a)
entries.excerpt: Mai Shiranui is the Beyonder's REM-002 personal geisha. She is the most skilled entertainer and performer of the crew, displaying combat choreographies and conversation, and has a fanatic devotion to the captain.

entries.name: Dancer Badr ul-Budūr (Jasmine; Badrul; Musa della Consumazione; formerly 001-4b)
entries.excerpt: Badr ul-Budūr, called Jasmine, is a highly skilled dancer in the Beyonders' crew REM-001. Her routines draw on her Middle Eastern heritage. In the Quadrante she is reused as the Muse of Consummation and as one third of Hecatekali REM-148 (see the titan Badrulb

entries.name: Butler E███ S███████ ("scarlett"; formerly 001-4c)
entries.excerpt: "scarlett" (E███ S███████) is a ranked member of the Beyonders' crew REM-001. Although she is effectively acting under the Word of Wyncham REM-043, the Beyonder REM-002 calls her his personal waitress, or butler.

entries.name: Pet ████████ ████████ (Yoruichi; also called [REM-019](#/rem-019); formerly 001-F1)
entries.excerpt: Yoruichi (Shihōin Yoruichi) is a captive held by the Beyonders, called a "pet". She is a woman with dark skin and purple hair, extremely agile and flexible, though unable to show her physical condition after her capture.

entries.name: Inmate K████ (fusion of F2a + F2b; formerly 001-F2)
entries.excerpt: An 18-year-old inmate of the Beyonders, from the DragonBall universe. She is a fusion of two females, REM-001-F2a and REM-001-F2b. She is prohibited from physical and mental exercise, but may mutate once a day for recreation and may split into her two componen

entries.name: Former dancer V████ (formerly 001-F3)
entries.excerpt: A 19-year-old former dancer held by the Beyonders, from the One Piece universe. No further details are given.

entries.name: Boundslaves (species; formerly 001-F█)
entries.excerpt: The Boundslaves are a captive species held by the Beyonders, with a lifespan of 100–120 years, from the Final Fantasy universe.

entries.name: Beyonder Frieza (B-Frieza; formerly 001-X1)
entries.excerpt: Beyonder Frieza (B-Frieza) is one of the Beyonders REM-001. He trained for thousands of years and gained immeasurable power. After his legendary battle with Rune King Son Goku REM-036 he had to replace his right arm with a mechanical, floating one, and his hea

entries.name: Executioner Belzebub Abimbola (formerly 001-X2)
entries.excerpt: Belzebub Abimbola is the executioner of the Beyonders REM-001, the judiciary institution of the world. He always wears armour and a black veil; only the Beyonder REM-002 knows his identity. He was once a slave and earned so much respect that he was given the a

entries.name: Meer Campbell (spokesperson; formerly 001-X3)
entries.excerpt: Meer Campbell is the spokesperson interviewed in the Beyonder logs. She introduces herself as "your guide to the infinite, and beyond!". In a 2022 log she says she no longer feels anything and that the admiral cannot stop giving her orders.

entries.name: Melina ("Prima Donna", Saint; formerly 001-X4)
entries.excerpt: Melina, the "Prima Donna", is a Saint in the 2023 Beyonders list: a protector of wayfarers, adventurers and fallen warriors. She was once a widow living in a mysterious forest, welcoming travellers into her hovel. Her left eye is permanently closed. The source

entries.name: Mistral (Android 22; formerly 001-X5)
entries.excerpt: Mistral (Android 22) is a cyborg in the 2023 Beyonders list. No further details are given.

entries.name: Nin (bondage model; formerly 001-X6)
entries.excerpt: Nin is listed in the 2023 Beyonders roster as a bondage model, a blonde woman. No further details are given.

entries.name: SAMARA (Park Eun-suh; formerly 001-X7)
entries.excerpt: SAMARA (Park Eun-suh) is a vengeful ghost in the 2023 Beyonders roster. As a dead woman her body is cold as ice and her eyes lifeless; she feels nothing but the cold of her own skin, and feels her body only when someone else touches it. She is often too weak t

entries.name: Vados (formerly 001-X8)
entries.excerpt: Vados is an angel met by the Beyonder REM-002 in the Silver City log, which took place immediately before a redacted incident. She greets him as "great leader" and asks the reason for his visit, then explains that one of the individuals he asks for is a fundam

entries.name: Marcarita (formerly 001-X9)
entries.excerpt: Marcarita is an angel met by the Beyonder REM-002 in the Silver City log, together with Vados REM-030. She refuses his request: "we simply cannot sacrifice a member of our own council for the unknown sake of another universe", and asks him, as "Grand Master",

entries.name: Sinia ("She who punishes"; formerly 001-X10)
entries.excerpt: Sinia, "She who punishes", is listed with the Hollow of Lily REM-044 as the most dangerous, evil and vengeful succubus. She is completely blind and can see only herself and her own desires. The source is explicit.

entries.name: Venxia ("She who slurps"; formerly 001-X11)
entries.excerpt: Venxia, "She who slurps", is a succubus listed with the Hollow of Lily REM-044 and also described in the Djesica Imperii magic notes.

entries.name: Researcher Betsy Braddock (formerly 001-X12)
entries.excerpt: Betsy Braddock is a researcher sent into the Hollow of Lily REM-044, the colossal flesh pit whose deepest point is the goddess Lilith's main body. Nobody who enters can reach that body because of the tentacles and obstacles. Thanks to superhuman abilities, Bra

entries.name: Researcher Diana TBA (formerly 001-X13)
entries.excerpt: Diana (surname listed as TBA) is a researcher who, with Betsy Braddock REM-034, is sent to explore and map the Hollow of Lily REM-044. Their superhuman abilities let them withstand the pit's tentacles. The source is explicit.

entries.name: Rune King Son Goku (formerly 001-X14)
entries.excerpt: Rune King Son Goku is a member of the Beyonders REM-001, known for a legendary battle with Beyonder Frieza REM-023.

entries.name: Anansi's Pot of Wisdom (formerly 001-A1)
entries.excerpt: Anansi's Pot of Wisdom is the artifact in which The Beyonder REM-002 sacrificed his eyes to gain full knowledge of the Many Worlds Interpretation and of the past.

entries.name: Freya's falcon cloak (formerly 001-A2)
entries.excerpt: Freya's falcon cloak is worn by The Beyonder REM-002, along with Aphrodite's girdle REM-039.

entries.name: Aphrodite's girdle (formerly 001-A3)
entries.excerpt: Aphrodite's girdle is worn by The Beyonder REM-002, along with Freya's falcon cloak REM-038.

entries.name: The Aegis (formerly 001-A4)
entries.excerpt: The Aegis is carried in The Beyonder's REM-002 left hand; one version says he wears it with the Cap of Darkness REM-042.

entries.name: All Black the Necrosword (formerly 001-A5)
entries.excerpt: All Black the Necrosword is wielded by The Beyonder REM-002 and kept in his shadow.

entries.name: Cap of Darkness (formerly 001-A6)
entries.excerpt: The Cap of Darkness is worn by The Beyonder REM-002 along with the Aegis REM-040.

entries.name: Word of Wyncham (formerly 001-A7)
entries.excerpt: The Word of Wyncham is the power The Beyonder REM-002 inherited by sacrificing his voice for a fraction of the Marquis of Death's REM-228 powers. With it he makes any fictional character obey his orders; it has cognitohazard effects on most conscious beings. S

entries.name: Hollow of Lily (Lili's Hollow; formerly 001-A8)
entries.excerpt: The Hollow of Lily (Lili's Hollow) is a colossal flesh pit whose deepest point is the main body of the goddess Lilith REM-920. Her intestinal villi spread into gigantic flesh walls, and tentacles grab whoever enters; no one who ventures inside is ever able to

entries.name: "Eve" (Eve of Paradis; Lucifer, Eve)
entries.excerpt: Eve (Object Class: Aetheric) is an entity resembling a humanoid female of Latino descent, of unparalleled beauty. She was once Lucifer REM-504, first-born daughter of Rangi REM-501 and Papa, titan of Time and Goddess of the Unknown, twin of Adam.

entries.name: Uomo Capovolto (The Upside-Down Man; The Upside Dawn of Man; Orpheus' Mirror; master puppeteer)
aliases: Ahah, The Upside Dawn of Man
entries.excerpt: The Upside-Down Man (Uomo Capovolto; also "The Upside Dawn of Man") is Orpheus' Mirror and the master puppeteer. In the Quadrante, the artist's body is no longer the artist's own because the Nyctophile REM-118 controls it; his Mirror is the Upside-Down Man, an

entries.name: Dio Nero (The Black God)
entries.excerpt: The Black God (Dio Nero) is the avatar of Orpheus REM-000. He once took a backpack full of stars and laid them in the paracosm as the Meridian of the Saints REM-102. His first son is Mbombo REM-103.

entries.name: Meridiano dei Santi (Meridian of Saints)
entries.excerpt: The Meridian of Saints is a constellation: the Black God REM-101, avatar of the puppeteer, once took a backpack full of stars and laid them across the paracosm as the Meridian of Saints.

entries.name: Mbombo
entries.excerpt: Mbombo is the first son of the Black God REM-101. He keeps vomiting the "horrible scenarios" the artist has prepared; among them he vomits Paradis. The pantheon of dreams he vomits can abandon itself to regain freedom as forgotten thoughts.

entries.name: The Lamp (La Lampada; Lampada di Idee / Lamp of Ideas; l'Osservatore / The Observer; The Aristocratic Artist)
entries.excerpt: The Lamp (also the Lamp of Ideas, the Observer, the Aristocratic Artist) is a fragment of the Prism REM-106. Originally the Observer, it became the Lamp; it lost its light and was left with only a few Genies.

entries.name: The Genies (Geni)
entries.excerpt: The Genies are the remaining genies of the Lamp. The Lamp says: "I'm the lamp that lost the light. I have only a few people left in my soul."

entries.name: Il Prisma (The Prism)
entries.excerpt: The Prism is the domain itself: not a container that traps but a consciousness observing itself, which must fragment in order to understand itself. Its shattering is constitutive: there was never an untouched domain that later divided, and all fragments arise

entries.name: Icarus (Icaro)
entries.excerpt: Icarus (Icaro) is a son of Orpheus REM-000; the sons of Orpheus are his own prayers. Icarus is the god of destruction. He does not forget or exile creation from the paracosm: he erases it completely. He is trauma, the indelible scar.

entries.name: Falari
entries.excerpt: Falari is the Goddess of Spacetime (chapter VII of the Quadrante). She is flayed and armoured in the skin of forgotten gods. She annihilated the Wargod Maelstrøm REM-135. The chapter contains explicit material.

entries.name: Prometheus (Prometeo; sword of Icarus)
entries.excerpt: Prometheus is the sword of REM-107: knowledge, curiosity, "the burning flame that the artist never puts out". Orpheus REM-000 prays to it as saviour of humanity and bearer of knowledge, and as the destruction of the Many Worlds.

entries.name: Aphrodite (Afrodite; The Untouchable Muse)
entries.excerpt: Aphrodite, the Untouchable Muse, is the artist's muse: the first woman and the most beautiful creature of the paracosm, living in the gardens of Eden. Her chapter in the Quadrante (VI) names her three aspects as Aphrodite, Hathor REM-112 and Eve REM-069; per t

entries.name: Messier Object 111
entries.object_class: EUCLID / DARK / CRITICAL, Level 2 (his, SCPs Ideas); docx says Keter
entries.excerpt: Messier Object 111 (Object Class: Keter) became a subject of study after contact with REM-902. When a test subject, Subject X, entered an empty cell, an entire dimension collapsed into 5×2.8 cubic metres, centred on the pupil of his left eye. His left eye beca

entries.name: Hathor (Musa della Passione / Muse of Passion)
entries.excerpt: Hathor, the Muse of Passion, is a goddess of beauty, sensuality and life (the sources gloss the name as "goddess of beauty, sensuality and fertility"). She is one of the three aspects of the muse with Aphrodite REM-110 and Eve REM-069.

entries.name: Abbaddon (Musa della Fine / Muse of the End)
entries.excerpt: Abbaddon, the Muse of the End, embodies pain, melancholy and death.

entries.name: Hephaestus (Efesto; Hḗphaistos)
entries.excerpt: Hephaestus (Efesto) is the young god of fire, the artisan who created with his hands instead of his voice. Before Orpheus REM-000 sang universes into existence and before the Prism REM-106 was shattered in three, the Prism was made almost entirely of two fragm

entries.name: Ishtar (Inanna; Inanna Morningstar; Ishtar Morningstar; Ste., Star Trooper Emeralda; Morning Star Nightmare; The Corruptor Goddess)
entries.excerpt: Ishtar (Inanna; Inanna or Ishtar Morningstar; Ste. Star Trooper Esmeralda; the Morning Star Nightmare; the Corruptor Goddess) is the goddess who binds Orpheus' REM-000 body to his throne. She corrupts his flesh, inducing carnal temptations; his favourite instr

entries.name: Il Cicisbeo (The Cicisbeo; the Incubus / Incubo)
entries.excerpt: The Cicisbeo is the lover for whom Ishtar REM-115 dances in the shadow of Orpheus REM-000. The narrator realises that Orpheus' body was the Cicisbeo, while only his soul kept walking in the void. Together with Ishtar he forms the Nyctophile REM-118. The Terrar

entries.name: Nyctophile (Nictofilo; Incubus Morningstar; The Merged Entity)
entries.excerpt: The Nyctophile, or Incubus Morningstar, is the dual entity formed by Ishtar REM-115 and the Cicisbeo REM-117, said to satisfy one's deepest desire. It is always present in the mind except before the light, and all sentient beings are said to have their own nyc

entries.name: La Musa (The Muse)
entries.excerpt: The Muse is the figure who shows each observer their highest desire; the source asks whether her appearance changes with who is looking. The text calls the darkness behind Orpheus REM-000 the seduction of his own daughter: Art, the Muse. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Muro di Geraas (Geraas Wall; Walls of Geraas)
entries.excerpt: The Geraas Wall is the "wall" between Art and the audience, made of unshared emotions, which the artifact (the performer or the artwork) must break down. In Paracosmia, the Star Troopers REM-132 begin building a wooden-like wall, the future Geraas Wall, around

entries.name: Scrittura Assamica (Assamic Script)
entries.excerpt: Assamic Script is the written transcription of song: to say something is to sing it into existence. For each vocal vibration, curves and lines represent pitch. The ~ marker visualises the tears of Orpheus REM-000 (see REM-122).

entries.name: Lacrima di Orfeo (Orpheus' Tear, the ~ marker)
entries.excerpt: Orpheus' Tear is the ~ symbol, used as a tear of Orpheus REM-000; the author's note says it changes with each paragraph.

entries.name: Chiesa della Luce (Church of Light)
entries.excerpt: The Church of Light is the church beyond all self, at whose centre Orpheus REM-000, Endless God of Dreams, sits on a nonexistent throne. His body is no longer the artist's, because the Nyctophile REM-118 controls it; his Mirror is the Upside-down Man REM-100.

entries.name: Messa Nera (Black Mass; Rito della Dimenticanza e del Ritorno / Rite of Forgetting and Return)
aliases: Rito della Dimenticanza e del Ritorno
entries.excerpt: The Black Mass, the Rite of Forgetting and Return, is the ceremony in which Aphrodite REM-110 sought freedom before Orpheus REM-000. She was fitted with a gas mask cut off from any oxygen and a pair of wings from a forgotten seraph, and disappeared upward, era

entries.name: Santo Graal (Holy Grail; golden chalice)
entries.excerpt: The Holy Grail is a golden chalice held by the bishop, "a protector of light and lethal weapon against darkness", seen after the Black Mass REM-124.

entries.name: Librarii Ofel Isandarìa
entries.excerpt: Librarii Ofel Isandarìa is a ring-shaped library, titanic and as big as a planet, holding billions of books and pieces of information. The artist draws on it to populate his own garden. It holds the Bestiary REM-127 and BLACKBOXXX REM-999.

entries.name: Il Bestiario (The Bestiary)
entries.excerpt: Il Bestiario (the Bestiary) is a vast encyclopedia, an almanac of artifacts, forgotten creations and "dimensional translations" between titans and deities. It records the Monsters REM-128: each Monster has its own entry, its own story, its inventor and its own

entries.name: Mostri (Monsters)
entries.image_caption: Monsters seen in the lower dimension. Ink sketch by the author.
entries.excerpt: Monsters (Mostri) are magical artifacts that were once organs of the ancient titans, the sons of the Ideas (the primordial titans). A titan that descends in dimension cannot be measured by that dimension. Its translation becomes an object with unknown, vast an

entries.name: Behemoth (Behemoths)
entries.excerpt: Behemoths are titans fully transformed in the lower dimension: the Council of Wargods REM-143 descended into full Behemoths there, while higher-ranked groups such as the Celestial Meridian REM-171 and the Four Horsemen REM-154 were half transformed.

entries.name: Joutsen
entries.excerpt: The Joutsen are the new titans: weaker than the ancient titans but still titans, descendants of Adam REM-503, and described as empty containers of magic. The ancient titans' later generations split in two: the Joutsen and the Saints (the gods), each Saint havi

entries.name: Saints (Santi)
entries.excerpt: The Saints are the first creatures, deities created in the image of Orpheus REM-000 and so each representing a part of the artist. The later generations split into the Joutsen REM-130, new and weaker titans descended from Adam, and the Saints, the gods. Each S

entries.name: Truppe Stellari (Star Troopers)
entries.excerpt: The Star Troopers were founded during the titanomachy by a subdomain of the Saints REM-131: soldiers trained from infancy. Early members include a mirrored image of REM-133, a young George Méliès and Belphegor REM-136. One killed a titan alone by tactics; anot

entries.name: St. Elias Yensid (Walt Disney)
entries.excerpt: St. Elias Yensid (Star Trooper; mirrored from Walt Disney) is a Wargod: the military god of the concrete environment, the artist's hand. On the Council he holds Environment. He embodies the absurdity of drawing and concertante skill; if he vanished, the Artist

entries.name: Remington Magnum .44 (Yensid's gun)
entries.excerpt: The .44 Remington Magnum belongs to the Military God REM-133. Its bullets contain different things, such as objects, materials, organisms and concepts; it can shoot a hydrogen bomb, or shoot memories, erasing them.

entries.name: Maelstrøm (Jean-Marie / Jean-Georges Malstrøm; George Méliès)
entries.excerpt: Maelstrøm (Jean-Marie or Jean-Georges Malstrøm; inspired by George Méliès) is a Star Trooper and Wargod: the military god of abstract defence; his Council seat is Science Defence. He is the inventor, the director, the magician. His projects rewrite the domain

entries.name: Belphegor Morningstar (Belfagor; St. Belphagor Morningstar)
entries.excerpt: Belphegor Morningstar (Belfagor) is a Star Trooper of the Morningstar family REM-259, "the insatiable Belfagor". He was a member of the first command meant to rule the artist's domain in place of Orpheus REM-000. In the Silver City he represents Laziness.

entries.name: Friona
entries.excerpt: Friona is a Star Trooper and legendary warrior, remembered for her deeds against a thousand titans. She was the first empress of Salolem REM-237 and the only being of Paradis more powerful than a god. Her letters are kept in the Library REM-126 as the Informat

entries.name: St. Merlin Jay Shuha (Merlino; Marlin)
entries.excerpt: St. Merlin Jay Shuha (Merlino) is a Star Trooper and druid god, remembered for his infallible tactics and diplomacy. He is the husband of REM-232. He took over the first command after Žvejys REM-141 left, and later abandoned the Table; afterwards Kristos was n

entries.name: The Hunter (Il Cacciatore)
entries.excerpt: The Hunter (Il Cacciatore) is an unnamed Star Trooper remembered for killing hundreds of titans.

entries.name: The White Death (Morte Bianca)
entries.excerpt: The White Death (Morte Bianca) is a Star Trooper: a sniper who stopped time whenever he ceased to move.

entries.name: Žvejys the Fisherman (Il Pescatore; Zveys dei Mobomimbisi)
entries.excerpt: Žvejys the Fisherman (Zveys of the Mobomimbisi) is a Star Trooper, "the blind destroyer of worlds". He was a member of the first command but left very early, became the Fisherman and retired to the pastures in the sky. He is the lover of Namygal Caesar REM-146

entries.name: Mobomimbisi (family)
entries.excerpt: Mobomimbisi is a family and a founding member of the Table of Wargods REM-143 who left almost immediately, for unknown reasons, and retired as The Fisherman (Žvejys). Some linked material is explicit.

entries.name: Wargods (Cani da Guerra; Table / Council of Wargods)
entries.excerpt: The Wargods (Table of War Dogs) are the five stars created by the gods to rule the artist's domain in place of Orpheus REM-000, after Ishtar REM-115 corrupted the artist. Members were Belphegor REM-136, Friona REM-137, Melies (later Maelstrøm REM-135), Yensid

entries.name: St. Goitsebeng Bomaye (The Inevitable Ngulu)
entries.excerpt: St. Goitsebeng Bomaye (the Inevitable Ngulu) is a Wargod: the military god of logistics. He is the performer and the executioner; he moulds the soul and morals, and stops them when they go too far. His Council seat is Finance. He executed Ion Henri REM-217.

entries.name: St. Messiaen Jay Shuha
entries.excerpt: St. Messiaen Jay Shuha is a Wargod: the military god of the Law, described as "a lack of spirituality, which existed in its time, and that perhaps will return in the future". He was defeated by the Man of Miracles. His forgotten brother is hypothesised to be A

entries.name: Ste. Namygal Caesar (Nami Gal)
entries.excerpt: Ste. Namygal Caesar (Nami Gal) is a Wargod: the military goddess of agriculture, the Storm Dragon REM-147. She represents the artist who fights hardship all the way to the stars, cultivating himself and his ambition. She is the lover of Žvejys the Fisherman RE

entries.name: Storm Dragon / Thunder Dragon (Drago della Tempesta / Drago del Tuono)
entries.excerpt: The Thunder Dragon is the dragon a TTF Delta-1 REM-308 agent becomes, per the prophecy that "the strongest of all [the Pisces] will rise to the stars, meeting the Thunder Dragon", so as to face St. Namygal; the catalogue calls it the dragon form of Namygal Cae

entries.name: Ste. Hecátekáli (Hekatekali; Boia / Executioner; Queen of Ragnarok)
entries.excerpt: Ste. Hecátekáli (Hekatekali; Boia, the Executioner; Queen of Ragnarok) is the supreme quintessence and judge of the gods. She is called Queen of Ragnarok for her incalculable destructive powers.

entries.name: Ander Ster
entries.excerpt: Ander Ster is one of the three titans that once formed Hecatekali REM-148, with Andro Meda REM-150 and Badrulbudur REM-151. With Andro Meda it gave rise to Orpheus REM-000 in the event called Absolute Zero.

entries.name: Andro Meda
entries.excerpt: Andro Meda is one of the three titans that once formed Hecatekali REM-148. With Ander Ster REM-149 it gave rise to Orpheus REM-000 in the event called Absolute Zero.

entries.name: Badrulbudur (titan)
entries.excerpt: Badrulbudur is the third of the three titans that once formed Hecatekali REM-148, with Ander Ster REM-149 and Andro Meda REM-150. The name is shared with the dancer Jasmine (Badr ul-Budūr) REM-017.

entries.name: San Shiva Parvati (Parvati family)
entries.excerpt: The Parvati family (San Shiva Parvati and his wife Parvati) sit on the small committee that assists Hecatekali REM-148. During a special ceremony they take on the Executioner's appearance: immersed in a tub full of a redacted blue liquid, they are transformed

entries.name: Thoth (Thoth LOI)
entries.excerpt: Thoth (Thoth LOI) is a member of the committee that assists Hecatekali REM-148, with the Parvati family REM-152 and Prometheus REM-109. In the Silver City he is the god of Knowledge.

entries.name: Quattro Cavalieri (Four Horsemen)
entries.excerpt: The Four Horsemen, inspired by Yuki-onna, Nietzsche, Camus and Lovecraft, are the main commanders of the Celestial Meridian REM-171. Each is assigned an army and they are called to arms by a horn. Phasis, Bearer of Death, commands the 1st division. In the lowe

entries.name: Phasis, Bringer of Death
entries.excerpt: Phasis, Bringer of Death, is one of the Four Horsemen, the main commanders of the Celestial Meridian REM-171, and commands its 1st division. Each Horseman has an army and is called to arms with a horn. The Horsemen were inspired by Yuki-onna, Nietzsche, Camus

entries.name: Diamonds Are Forever (sword)
entries.excerpt: Diamonds Are Forever is the favourite weapon of Phasis, Bearer of Death: a sword of diamonds and ice that Phasis can draw from any part of the body. It fell on a planet and turned it to ice; Jai REM-178 lifted it and became one with it (see REM-247).

entries.name: Mutoryu Oiseaux techniques
entries.excerpt: Mutoryu Oiseaux is the sword school of Phasis. Its techniques, from weakest to strongest, begin with Hanauta Sanchou: Yahazu Giri REM-158 and Hanauta Sanchou: Yuki no mai REM-162.

entries.name: Hanauta Sanchou: Yahazu Giri
entries.excerpt: Hanauta Sanchou: Yahazu Giri is the weakest Mutoryu Oiseaux REM-157 technique: the user moves so fast that the cut is noticed only a few seconds later.

entries.name: Hanauta Sanchou: Gamengiri
entries.excerpt: A technique of the Mutoryu Oiseaux sword school REM-157. Gamengiri: the user stands with their back to the opponent, sword held in front with both hands and the blade turned toward themselves, then turns rapidly and strikes.

entries.name: Hanauta Sanchou: Harakiri
entries.excerpt: A technique of the Mutoryu Oiseaux sword school REM-157. Harakiri: the sword is in the right hand with the left hand above it, the hilt placed at the right side of the abdomen; the user then pierces the opponent on the left side of the abdomen.

entries.name: Hanauta Sanchou: Yakkodori
entries.excerpt: A technique of the Mutoryu Oiseaux sword school REM-157. Yakkodori: the sword, in the right hand, is extended with its tip to the right touching the ground; the user then launches a projectile slash that will not stop for miles.

entries.name: Yuki no mai
entries.excerpt: A technique of the Mutoryu Oiseaux sword school REM-157. Yuki no mai: the user grips the sword with both hands and brings it from behind the back to the front; the coldness of the blade's movement creates cold vapours that freeze the frontal attack, so in prac

entries.name: Shibire
entries.excerpt: A technique of the Mutoryu Oiseaux sword school REM-157. Shibire: the same stance as Yuki no mai REM-162 but with the blade held in one hand. The target's body notices the attack only after hours or even days.

entries.name: Warai Sanchou: Baccarat
entries.excerpt: A technique of the Mutoryu Oiseaux sword school REM-157. Warai Sanchou: Baccarat is basically a reversed Yuki no mai REM-162 without bringing the sword behind the back. The slash is so forceful it can appear in any direction, and the user trusts their luck for

entries.name: Aisusukai
entries.excerpt: A technique of the Mutoryu Oiseaux sword school REM-157. Aisusukai: the sword stays motionless while the user rests a hand on the side of the blade; any following attack passes through the side of the sword.

entries.name: Gyojin Sanchou: Surasshu / Ryu Samehada
entries.excerpt: A technique of the Mutoryu Oiseaux sword school REM-157. Gyojin Sanchou: Surasshu is a simple sword slash using the Fishman Karate technique. The opponent is deformed; it is used against Haki users to bypass their armour.

entries.name: O no ha
entries.excerpt: A technique of the Mutoryu Oiseaux sword school REM-157. O no ha: the user charges the attack like the King's Punch, but instead of punching performs a sword technique.

entries.name: Innominandum, Bringer of Famine
entries.excerpt: Innominandum, Bringer of Famine, is the Horseman commanding the 2nd division of the Celestial Meridian REM-171. He wears a cloak; the only visible parts of his body are his face, always covered by a stoic Lovecraftian mask, his left arm, which strangely ends i

entries.name: Planetes, Bringer of War
entries.excerpt: Planetes, Bringer of War, is the Horseman commanding the 3rd division of the Celestial Meridian REM-171. He is killed by Icarus REM-107.

entries.name: Novembre VII (November VII), Bringer of Conquest
entries.excerpt: November VII (Novembre VII), Bringer of Conquest, is the Horseman commanding the 4th division of the Celestial Meridian REM-171. He leaves the Four.

entries.name: Meridiano Celeste (Celestial Meridian; Tre Cavalieri)
entries.excerpt: The Celestial Meridian began as the Three Horsemen, who declared war on the Wargods REM-143. Its main commanders are the Four Horsemen REM-154, each assigned an army and called to arms by a horn. In the lower dimension its members are half transformed. The Pek

entries.name: Cavalieri Sacri (Holy Knights)
entries.excerpt: The Holy Knights appear in the fate of the Holy Bishop REM-000, the first light of the paracosm: the gods of war seal him from his creation, the Upside-down Man REM-100 steals his powers, and the Holy Knights steal his name.

entries.name: Kristos Jay Shuha
entries.excerpt: Kristos Jay Shuha has no apparent powers, so he is sent to the sewers, and his brother Messiaen is appointed in his place. Paracosmia later calls him Kristos, the future Machinist REM-XXX, who arrives with the Archon REM-180 to recruit Jai REM-178.

entries.name: Antikristos Jay Shuha
entries.excerpt: Antikristos Jay Shuha is the forgotten brother of St. Messiaen Jay Shuha REM-145. The Machinist REM-XXX, founder of the Orem, is hypothesised to be him, as is Dedalus, the first inventor recorded in Libra history. The catalogue notes he was conceived via Metat

entries.name: Jai Bird (Jai)
entries.excerpt: Jai Bird (alias Blue Pheasant) is an agent of TTF Phi-1 REM-001. He is a male Libra (African-American).

entries.name: June (the Machinist's daughter)
entries.excerpt: June is the Machinist's REM-XXX daughter. In one scene she reaches out from the cabin and approaches him smiling while he speaks with Jai Bird REM-178. The Machinist dropped her onto Tuonela REM-212, destroying the planet.

entries.name: L'Arconte (The Archon)
entries.excerpt: The Archon arrives with Kristos, the future Machinist, and recruits Jai REM-178 into the Beyonders squad REM-001 after he lifts Phasis' sword.

entries.name: The Man of Miracles (L'Uomo dei Miracoli)
entries.excerpt: The Man of Miracles (L'Uomo dei Miracoli) is a TTF Phi-1 REM-001 agent, a male Libra (Estonian). His artifact is a pair of glasses; his attacks include Load-Aim-Shoot and Shinosses.

entries.name: Victor Sierra
entries.excerpt: Victor Sierra appears in the Paracosmia chronology, searching for a pattern (or model) with the shinigami.

entries.name: Spokesperson (of the Machinist)
entries.excerpt: The Spokesperson is the official spokesperson of the Organization, whose name is expunged, introducing themself as "your guide to the infinite, and beyond!". The interview log was interrupted several times, possibly by the Machinist REM-XXX himself, and the ti

entries.name: Hana Nanami (Hana)
entries.excerpt: Hana Nanami is the Machinist's REM-XXX personal maid, considered intelligent and sharp, with sophisticated acting skills; the interview calls her a possible muse of the author. She identifies herself as "your admiral's favourite symbol", a former nickname of t

entries.name: Metatron
entries.excerpt: Metatron is a resident of the Silver City REM-186 who, in a record by TTF Omega-1 REM-307 during expedition XLII, bows before the Machinist and asks the reason for his visit. The record is marked to be deleted and is flagged explicit.

entries.name: Città d'Argento (The Silver City)
entries.excerpt: The Silver City is the home of two residents whose interaction with the Machinist was recorded by TTF Omega-1 REM-307 during expedition XLII of the Arcane's ship.

entries.name: Nave dell'Arcano (The Arcano's ship)
entries.excerpt: The Arcane's ship is the vessel of expedition XLII, during which the Machinist visited the Silver City REM-186. Deities authorised for daily reuse are brought back to it.

entries.name: Qagela
entries.excerpt: Qagela is a fusion of multiple constellation specimens, used mainly for recreational purposes. It is listed among the Machinist's possessions with the body of REM-151 and his daughter Arte REM-189. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Arte (the Machinist's daughter)
entries.excerpt: Arte is the Machinist's daughter, who is secretly a bomb capable of destroying the whole paracosm.

entries.name: Antenna Spaziale (The Antenna; Space Antenna)
entries.excerpt: The Space Antenna is an elevator inside a portal connected to the paracosm, and the Machinist's office. It is controlled by TTF Omega-1 REM-307 together with the satellites, the Rods from God and the space stations.

entries.name: Willbreaker
entries.excerpt: Willbreaker is a sword: touching it inspires fear, and it pierces the victim's will. Touching the hilt makes victims see themselves cut even while it is sheathed; partly unsheathed, it breaks the will of everything around it, objects included. Its owner and cr

entries.name: Bypass Agent™ (formula / virus)
entries.excerpt: Bypass Agent™ is a formula that can replace a person's brain, making them a brainless agent driven by the formula. The Library entry describes it as a virus made of decryption information.

entries.name: INFORMATION HAZARD "FIRST EMPRESS"
entries.excerpt: INFORMATION HAZARD "First Empress" is the letters of Friona REM-137, first empress of Salolem REM-237 and the only being of Paradis more powerful than a god, kept in the Library REM-126.

entries.name: Laka Imperii
entries.excerpt: Laka Imperii is an empire where, for parades, people may be lobotomised and revived. The surrounding text on what happens to bodies is explicit and kept in the source excerpts.

entries.name: Il Formicaio (The Anthill)
entries.excerpt: The Anthill (Il Formicaio) is the training facility of the Organization. Terra Task Force personnel, "the best of the best" of the Orem, are drawn from it.

entries.name: Terrario (Terrarium)
entries.excerpt: The Terrarium is the creation in the sewers of the Pastures in the Sky REM-242. The Zodiac was born from the vomit of Mbombo REM-103: the imperfect reflection of the body of Orpheus REM-000 or, in plain words, the most unruly desires of the cicisbeo; lesser mu

entries.name: Lo Zodiaco (The Zodiac; Morfei of the demiurge; lesser Muses)
entries.excerpt: The Zodiac was born from the vomit of Mbombo REM-103 in the Terrarium REM-196: the imperfect reflection of the body of Orpheus REM-000, the most unruly desires of the Cicisbeo REM-117, "Morphei of the demiurge", lesser muses.

entries.name: Virgo (Homo persephone)
entries.excerpt: Virgo (Homo persephone) are sapient organisms living in the waters of Paradis, with a humanoid body and a tail; called the most beautiful creature on Paradis. They live in the northern hemisphere in mangrove forests, and rarely ventured into the deep forests,

entries.name: Ilanga
entries.excerpt: The Ilanga live in the deep forests of Paradis. They never attacked the tribes alone but were practically impossible to destroy in hordes. One of them hated other Ilanga, killing them at every encounter, and so was a lone hunter.

entries.name: Elzaidir
entries.excerpt: Elzaidir is credited for an image in the Paradis biology notes ("Image credit to Elzaidir").

entries.name: Fiamma (Ignition Magic, Paradis)
entries.excerpt: Fiamma (Ignition Magic) is the magic system of Paradis: every species on the planet transforms, via ignition, into "something". Ignition varies: whether the body burns inside, the environment burns, the soul burns, or it burns in negative.

entries.name: White Mass (Missa of Words and Life, Doppelgänger)
aliases: Missa of Words and Life, Doppelgänger
entries.excerpt: White Mass (Missa of Words and Life) is the magic system of Doppelgänger REM-279: magic power accumulates the longer and harder a fight lasts, so ordinary martial artists can beat magicians in short encounters, while magicians tend to win on theatre stages. Wo

entries.name: Umbra (Shadow Magic, Phantasus)
entries.excerpt: Umbra (Shadow Magic) is the magic system of Phantasus REM-281; "that's exactly what it looks like."

entries.name: Color of Clockworks (Gear Magic, Tuonela)
entries.excerpt: Color of Clockworks (Gear Magic) is the magic system of Tuonela REM-212: every titan controls a set of conceptual gears, creating a unique ability. Charon, for example, can distort and observe objects at extreme distances.

entries.name: Charon (titan)
entries.excerpt: Charon is a titan of the Color of Clockworks REM-204 (gear magic), in which every titan controls a set of conceptual gears that gives a unique ability. Charon can distort and observe objects at extreme distances and join them to the same orbit.

entries.name: Pendulum (titan)
entries.excerpt: Pendulum is a titan of the Color of Clockworks REM-204 (gear magic). He can switch gears to gain more or less power.

entries.name: Kamehameha the Juggernaut (titan)
entries.excerpt: Kamehameha the Juggernaut is a titan of the Color of Clockworks REM-204 (gear magic). He can travel along one gear, or "orbit", and cannot be stopped unless the centre of that orbit is disrupted.

entries.name: Ouroboros (titan)
entries.excerpt: Ouroboros is a titan of the Color of Clockworks REM-204 (gear magic). He creates the gear constructs the other titans use.

entries.name: Iapetus (titan)
entries.excerpt: Iapetus is a titan of the Color of Clockworks REM-204 (gear magic). He creates sniper gears from his eyes.

entries.name: Gates (Soul Magic)
entries.excerpt: Gates (Soul Magic) is the magic system of the entire universe, because the universe is the mind of the demiurge titan.

entries.name: Yggdrasil
entries.excerpt: Yggdrasil is named in the TTF files: Jai Bird's REM-178 time manipulation can freeze Yggdrasil in its entirety.

entries.name: Tuonela (formerly Valhalla)
entries.excerpt: Tuonela, formerly Valhalla, is a planet in the reality dimension where the Joutsen REM-130 were able to live, because they were essentially empty containers for magic. The catalogue record notes it was destroyed by June. When the Beyonders' REM-002 ship arrive

entries.name: "Limbo" (TTF Zeta-1)
entries.excerpt: TTF Zeta-1 "Limbo" is a secret Terra Task Force formed from former TTF Alpha-1 REM-310, Alpha-2 and Beta-2 personnel, now highly qualified for logistics. It is captained by the TTF Phi-1 agent the Man of Miracles REM-181 and specialises in following his moveme

entries.name: Eden Hyperverse
entries.excerpt: The Eden Hyperverse is a collection of universes that adhere to the Many Worlds Interpretation of quantum mechanics. At about 19.8 billion years of age, Boman REM-000, whose early creations were "bubbles", each a universe, expanded his domain into it; it is hi

entries.name: Arcadia
entries.excerpt: Arcadia is a sector of the Church of Light REM-123 stolen from the gods, where Eve resides as a hostage. The artist has painted Arcadia many times, with Aphrodite REM-110, his muse, in the gardens of Eden.

entries.name: Guerra Eoniana (Eonian Wars)
entries.excerpt: The Eonian War is the war from which the Machinist REM-XXX is supposed to save all constellations; a narrator calls him the most sadistic, evil and dangerous being in the paracosm.

entries.name: Ion Henri (John Henry; Iohn Henri)
entries.excerpt: Ion Henri (John Henry) called the council of gods the War Dogs, as the Machinist also does. The catalogue records him as the thief of the Tecnica REM-218, executed by Bomaye, who becomes a falling star.

entries.name: La Tecnica (The Technique)
entries.excerpt: The Tecnica ("the Technique") is the stolen divine art of making artifacts. It was stolen in a dream, and the Machinist divided it among the Orem.

entries.name: Monkey-queen form of Falari (Hanuman / Sun Wukong)
entries.excerpt: The monkey-queen form is what remains of Falari REM-108 after a ten-hour flaying: something divine reduced to a grotesque simulacrum of the human, resembling Hanuman or Sun Wukong. The account is explicit and kept in the source excerpts.

entries.name: Amaterasu
entries.excerpt: One of the five deities whose powers the A.N.G.E.L. Suit REM-420 harnesses. Amaterasu provides the energy the suit metabolises; her disappearance would make the device completely useless.

entries.name: Nabu
entries.excerpt: One of the five deities whose powers the A.N.G.E.L. Suit REM-420 harnesses. Nabu provides wisdom. Nabu no longer exists, and with him the collective memory of the god, so the device is no longer usable without a replacement; the Orem synthesised the Lilith fun

entries.name: Gilgamesh
entries.excerpt: One of the five deities whose powers the A.N.G.E.L. Suit REM-420 harnesses. Gilgamesh provides strength. Without Gilgamesh the user remains invulnerable but can do nothing else.

entries.name: Esfandiyār
entries.excerpt: One of the five deities whose powers the A.N.G.E.L. Suit REM-420 harnesses. Esfandiyār provides invulnerability, which works only inside the paracosm; outside the fiction the user would cease to exist like any other matter. Without Esfandiyār the user's body s

entries.name: Laka
entries.excerpt: One of the five deities whose powers the A.N.G.E.L. Suit REM-420 harnesses. Laka provides the stamina that lets the user endure the suit's energy; without Laka, the overwhelming energy burns the user to death.

entries.name: The One Above All
entries.excerpt: The One Above All, the writer of the MARVEL outerverse, is cited as an example of a metaversal subject, alongside the Empty Hand REM-227 for DC.

entries.name: The Empty Hand
entries.excerpt: The Empty Hand, the writer of the DC outerverse, is cited as an example of a metaversal subject, alongside The One Above All REM-226 for MARVEL.

entries.name: The Marquis of Death (Marchese della Morte)
entries.excerpt: The Marquis of Death is cited as an outerversal example: he controls all of the MARVEL outerverse after travelling from his own. In the analytical example he is a (∞-1)° archversal character who controls every aspect of MARVEL except himself. The Beyonder REM-

entries.name: Dr. Manhattan
entries.excerpt: Dr. Manhattan is cited as an outerversal example: he controls all of the DC outerverse after travelling from his own.

entries.name: Saitama
entries.excerpt: Saitama is cited in the scale of characters as a parody of the archetype character who beats everyone.

entries.name: Oblivion
entries.excerpt: Oblivion is cited as a hyperversal example: he is everything that can be written in the MARVEL outerverse.

entries.name: Samsara of Dumas
entries.excerpt: Samsara of Dumas was born into a family of healers and mystics in the ancient city of Dumas and showed an unusual connection to spiritual energies from an early age. She is the wife of Merlin Jay Shuha REM-138. Her attribute is protection.

entries.name: Apollyon Khan
entries.excerpt: Apollyon Khan is the emperor of the Annuaki REM-320, the technologically advanced nation of bloodthirsty titans that inhabits Tuonela REM-212. They hunted angels to genocide and destroyed Tuonela's atmosphere by constantly testing atomic and hydrogen bombs. He

entries.name: The Central Mind
entries.excerpt: The Central Mind is the paracosm's central mind, named in the title of the text "Central Mind In The Dark".

entries.name: Salolem
entries.excerpt: Salolem is the empire of which Friona REM-137 was the first empress; she is the only being of Paradis more powerful than a god.

entries.name: Peerage
entries.excerpt: The Peerage is the group of "good" or neutral deities in Arcadia REM-215, described in the documentary-style book "Arcadia".

entries.name: Ford Prefect
entries.excerpt: Ford Prefect is one of two speakers, with "WHO?", in the Italian saga notes "The Orem", written as a chat. His passages cover the theft and execution of John Henry REM-217.

entries.name: The War of Angelokia
entries.excerpt: The War of Angelokia is the war in which the titans erase all angels. Paracosmia's account of this era describes the Saints at war with the titans and the founding of the Star Troopers REM-132, whose first members included Maelstrom REM-135, Elias Yensid, Belp

entries.name: Angelic Wars / Titanomakia
entries.excerpt: The Angelic Wars, or Titanomakia, are the war of the Saints REM-131 against the titans, during which the Star Troopers REM-132 were founded.

entries.name: Pascoli nel cielo (Pastures in the Sky)
entries.image_caption: "Quadrant of the pastures in the sky, seen from the sewers" (from Il Quadrante delle emozioni)
entries.excerpt: The Pastures in the Sky are the territory of the Star Troopers REM-132: called extremely small, although infinite. The Troopers walled it with what became the Geraas Wall REM-120. The Terrarium REM-196 lies in its sewers.

entries.name: Prairies of the Church of Light
entries.excerpt: Under the Church of Light REM-123, Orpheus REM-000 built infinite prairies.

entries.name: Unnamed titan-killing Star Trooper
entries.excerpt: An unnamed Star Trooper REM-132 who killed a titan alone, by tactics.

entries.name: Icarus' ten children
entries.excerpt: Icarus REM-107 has ten children, each inheriting a part of his power.

entries.name: Ice planet (Phasis' sword planet)
entries.excerpt: The ice planet was rendered completely ice when Phasis' sword REM-156 fell on it. Jai REM-178, from this planet, lifted the sword and became one with it; the future Machinist then arrived with the Archon and recruited him into the Beyonders squad.

entries.name: Armageddon Loop
entries.excerpt: The Armageddon Loop contains Lily Springs REM-911, the "blossom of Lilith", whose exact coordinates are classified; Lilith REM-920 is contained on its largest asteroid. The blueprint of REM-420 is kept in an unknown space station orbiting it. TTF Omega-1 REM-3

entries.name: Byrd (of Paradis family)
entries.excerpt: Byrd is a god listed in the "of Paradis" family in Pascoli nel cielo. No further details are given.

entries.name: Anubis (of Paradis family)
entries.excerpt: Anubis is a god of the "of Paradis" family, listed with Hathor, Thoth and Ra in Pascoli nel cielo. No further details are given.

entries.name: Ra (of Paradis family, Pascoli)
entries.excerpt: Ra is listed as a god of the "of Paradis" family in Pascoli nel cielo. See also Ra REM-505.

entries.name: Equinox (of Dumas)
entries.excerpt: Equinox is a god of the Dumas family in Pascoli nel cielo, who "perfectly balances everything". The same family includes Samsara REM-232 (protection).

entries.name: Ki family
entries.excerpt: The Ki family is listed in the Pastures in the Sky notes; the catalogue records it as the family of Low the librarian.

entries.name: Low (librarian, Ki family)
entries.excerpt: Low is a librarian god of the Ki family (marked LOI) in Pascoli nel cielo. No further details are given.

entries.name: Addams family
entries.excerpt: The Addams family is listed in the Pastures in the Sky notes; the catalogue records it as the family of the Upside Dawn of Man and Dogg Glass.

entries.name: Dogg Glass, God of Nothing
entries.excerpt: Dogg Glass is the God of Nothing ("Orbiting"), listed in Pascoli nel cielo.

entries.name: Morningstar family
entries.excerpt: The Morningstar family controls the Geraas Walls REM-120. They wear a vest covering the body, which is why they are corrupted by the winds outside the walls.

entries.name: Satan (goat, tiqbalang)
entries.excerpt: Satan, listed as a goat and tiqbalang, manipulates CHAMBERS such as Prison and Terrain. Listed in Pascoli nel cielo near Belphagor ("horns") and Lucifer REM-504.

entries.name: Marcus Anguta (Marcus Morningstar)
entries.excerpt: Marcus Anguta (Marcus Morningstar) is listed as Typhon, the Marquis of Death: a reversed body, a collector of multiple souls with multiple lives. He is placed in the Geraas Wall REM-120 sector of Pascoli nel cielo.

entries.name: Nosferatu (half girl half beast)
entries.excerpt: Nosferatu, "half girl, half beast", is a member of the Morningstar family listed in Pascoli nel cielo (also noted as "nosferatu, yeti").

entries.name: Baʿal Zebub
entries.excerpt: Baʿal Zebub is the god of the deep white, also called god of the Skies, in Pascoli nel cielo. His son is Bęlu REM-265.

entries.name: Bęlu
entries.excerpt: Bęlu is the son of Baʿal Zebub REM-264: a cat-king frog with rotating heads, also described as a cat wearing a moose skull.

entries.name: Cain Morningstar
entries.excerpt: Cain Morningstar wears a bag holding the dead body of his brother Abel REM-267. He can connect the two bodies and use both: the same legs with two upper bodies, front and back. His third form is a Janus double face with double half arms.

entries.name: Abel Morningstar
entries.excerpt: Abel Morningstar is the dead brother whose body Cain Morningstar REM-266 carries in a bag and fuses with.

entries.name: Seth
entries.excerpt: Seth is listed among the figures of the Geraas Wall REM-120 sector in Pascoli nel cielo. No further details are given.

entries.name: Rati (wooden arm)
entries.excerpt: Rati (name uncertain in the source) is a figure with a wooden arm and writings, listed in the sector notes of the Pastures in the Sky.

entries.name: Uomo cappello di fungo (Mushroom-hat man)
entries.excerpt: The mushroom-hat man is a figure with writings, listed in the sector notes of the Pastures in the Sky.

entries.name: Shikigami
entries.excerpt: Shikigami are spirits populating the Prairies in the Sky with the Saints. They look like variants of eels; some horses even have half their bodies eel-like.

entries.name: Thunderbird
entries.excerpt: The thunderbird is a creature listed in the sky-sector notes of the Pastures in the Sky.

entries.name: Praying monk with a tesseract face
entries.excerpt: A praying monk with a tesseract in place of a face, listed in the sky-sector notes of the Pastures in the Sky.

entries.name: Yeti
entries.excerpt: The yeti is a creature listed, with the nosferatu, in the sky-sector notes of the Pastures in the Sky.

entries.name: Forest of the dead (outside Geraas Walls)
entries.excerpt: The Forest of the Dead lies outside the Geraas Walls REM-120: blood rivers, carcass land, body trees and cold winds. Seen from inside the walls, whoever goes there slows in time until completely stuck, as on the event horizon of a black hole, and the body deca

entries.name: Buca della Fucina (Forge pit, wormhole)
entries.excerpt: The Forge pit (Buca della Fucina) is a wormhole link with the underlying dimension, listed in the notes for the map of the Pastures REM-242 alongside the library, the Yggdrasil-like river and the Church of Light.

entries.name: Corno (war horn)
entries.excerpt: The war horn calls the Four Horsemen REM-154 to arms; the splash-page notes show knights on the mountains while other gods scramble and dress for war.

entries.name: Hel system
entries.excerpt: The Hel system is the star system at the centre of the paracosm map. It has a diameter of about 84 AU, with the Leti debris disk REM-280 between 34.67 and 42 AU; at those two points lie the biggest dwarf planet, Doppelgangger REM-279, and the smallest, Phantas

entries.name: Doppelgänger (planet)
entries.excerpt: Doppelgänger ("double, twin", referring to Tuonela REM-212) is the biggest dwarf planet of the Hel system REM-278, at the inner edge of the Leti debris REM-280. The catalogue lists it as a lower-dimension world tied to REM-202 magic.

entries.name: Leti debris
entries.excerpt: The Leti debris ("detritus of the edge") is the debris disk of the Hel system REM-278, between 34.67 and 42 AU, bounded by the dwarf planets Doppelgangger REM-279 and Phantasus REM-281.

entries.name: Phantasus (planet)
entries.excerpt: Phantasus ("fantasy") is the smallest dwarf planet of the Hel system REM-278, at the outer edge of the Leti debris REM-280. Its existence is only speculated; it has never been seen, hence the name. The catalogue lists it as a lower-dimension world (Umbra magic

entries.name: Hedron Icosa
entries.excerpt: Hedron Icosa is listed among the other planets of the lower dimension. No further details are given.

entries.name: Apollyon, Emperor of the Moons
entries.excerpt: Apollyon, Emperor of the Moons, is a government figure of The Forge listed in Pascoli nel cielo. See also Apollyon Khan REM-233.

entries.name: Mackintosh chair (Wargods' table)
entries.excerpt: A Mackintosh chair at the table of the Wargods REM-143, noted for a splash page.

entries.name: The Organization (the Orem; Mobile Task Forces)
entries.excerpt: The Orem (the Organization), the "theorem", is an organisation of lower creatures created to unite all creatures and defeat the gods: an ant is nothing against a praying mantis, but a mantis would be annihilated by a whole anthill. Its units attack the body of

entries.name: Subject F-12
entries.excerpt: Subject F-12 was a heavily armoured, mobile prototype weapon designed to escape containment. In Incident 467-01 a Stalker REM-467 was deployed to track and neutralise it, and pursued it relentlessly despite its power.

entries.name: Captain Barbarossa

entries.name: Goddess of the Spiral
entries.excerpt: The Goddess of the Spiral is a goddess whose domain was the scene of Incident 467-07: during an operation against a celestial meridian there, a Pekka unit (see REM-467) was deployed and, after 72 hours of continuous pursuit, neutralised the threat at significa

entries.name: Cleansing Ritual
entries.excerpt: The Cleansing Ritual is performed regularly by Eve REM-069: she submerges herself in a pool of water infused with biological matter which, though unpleasant, she reports rejuvenates her appearance and abilities, maintaining her apparent immortality.

entries.name: Director of the Lily Springs Project
entries.excerpt: The Director of the Lily Springs Project REM-911. Access to Lilith REM-920 is prohibited without the Director's clearance; unauthorised attempts to breach containment or disturb the organism's growth are met with immediate termination.

entries.name: The Forge
entries.excerpt: The Forge is a red star surrounded by a Dyson sphere. The star is made of cremated gods, used to forge the armour of the Stalkers, the special force "Pekka" able to face and hunt the gods (see REM-316).

entries.name: TTF Omega-1
entries.excerpt: TTF Omega-1 ("Astral") is the Terra Task Force deployed in space. It controls all satellites, the Rods from God, the Space Antenna REM-190 and the space stations across the universes. It monitors the cultivation and maintenance of a space fungus on REM-248 and

entries.name: TTF Delta-1 (Pisces)
entries.excerpt: TTF Delta-1 ("Privateers", "Pirates") is formed by military personnel deployed in the open sea. TTF Gamma-1 REM-315 personnel must mix with the pisces specimens to trigger an Astral-Dragon Scenario. They attack islands by digging tunnels or by aerial manoeuvre

entries.name: TTF Alpha-1 ("Leeches")
entries.excerpt: TTF Alpha-1 ("Leeches") is formed by berserkers drugged during sexual activity, after which all its personnel gain hysterical strength and unmeasured stamina. The Leeches are extremely violent and brutal on missions. Like all Terra Task Forces, it is an elite

entries.name: TTF Alpha-2 ("Support Class")
entries.excerpt: TTF Alpha-2 ("Support Class") is formed by snipers, paramedics and suppliers. It is usually deployed with TTF Alpha-3 REM-312 or Beta-1 REM-313 and cannot be deployed on its own.

entries.name: TTF Alpha-3 ("Enhanced Interrogators")
entries.excerpt: TTF Alpha-3 ("Enhanced Interrogators") is formed by highly trained personnel formerly used to test different torture methods; all its members can endure immense pain.

entries.name: TTF Beta-1 ("Chicks")
entries.excerpt: TTF Beta-1 ("Chicks") is formed by newly employed personnel awaiting assignment, rookies, relegated agents and non-military volunteers. The Chicks are usually assigned to extremely dangerous missions.

entries.name: TTF Beta-2 ("Fatale")
entries.excerpt: TTF Beta-2 ("Fatale") is formed by undercover agents whose duties range across espionage, infiltration and assassination. They wear whatever best suits the task, from ordinary to elegant clothing.

entries.name: TTF Gamma-1 ("Privateers")
entries.excerpt: TTF Gamma-1 ("Privateers") is formed by military personnel deployed on the open seas. All its captains have contracts with demons that grant them abilities. Its personnel mix with the pisces specimens to trigger an Astral-Dragon Scenario (see TTF Delta-1 REM-3

entries.name: TTF Tau-1 ("Pekka")
entries.excerpt: TTF Tau-1 ("Pekka") is formed by all agents together with TTF Alpha-1 REM-310, Alpha-2, Psi-1 and Omega-1, and is deployed only in apocalyptic scenarios. Pekka units appear in the Stalker incidents (see REM-467).

entries.name: TTF Upsilon-1 ("Succubus")
entries.excerpt: TTF Upsilon-1 ("Succubus") is formed by TTF Beta-1 REM-313 and Beta-2 personnel infected by a space fungus. They are deployed in space on missions that do not need TTF Omega-1 REM-307. The fungus, harvested by Omega-1, is controlled indirectly by the Conductor

entries.name: TTF Psi-1 ("Tartarus")
entries.excerpt: TTF Psi-1 ("Tartarus") is formed by captured deities from other universes, repurposed to serve the Organization. It is deployed to eliminate Apollyon Khan REM-233.

entries.name: Terra Task Forces (TTFs)
entries.excerpt: Terra (Terrarium) Task Forces are elite units drawn from across the Orem, mobilised against threats that exceed the capacity of regular field personnel and relocated between facilities as needed; their personnel are "the best of the best". They train at the An

entries.name: Annuaki (Annuaki War)

entries.name: Zheng Yi Sao (grand fleet)
entries.excerpt: Zheng Yi Sao commands the grand fleet of the Terra Task Force deployed on the open sea, which hunts pisces and prevents an Astral-Dragon Scenario (see REM-308). Another captain is Anthony Barbarossa REM-322.

entries.name: Anthony Barbarossa
entries.excerpt: Anthony Barbarossa is a living skeleton with a burning beard, one of the important captains of the grand fleet commanded by Zheng Yi Sao REM-321.

entries.name: Sauelsuesor, Angel of Advise
entries.excerpt: Sauelsuesor is the Angel of Advice ("Advise" in the source), listed in the pantheon of an untitled document alongside Loki, God of Stories.

entries.name: Thoth (UD pantheon)
entries.excerpt: In the pantheon of an untitled document, Thoth is the God of Knowledge and Prometheus REM-109 the God of Advancement. In the Quadrante, the sword Prometheus is knowledge and curiosity, "the burning flame that the artist never puts out". See also Thoth of the H

entries.name: Angels (Anjelic War)
entries.excerpt: The Angels are a nation of so-called "perfect" beings, and so androgynous; in reality a corrupted, racist nation that exterminated or held captive half of themselves. They reach their fullest power in orgies, which is why they appear from a distance as seraphi

entries.name: Mirialan (crew species)
entries.excerpt: The Mirialan are a crew species named in the notes; the definition is unfinished ("The mirialan are").

entries.name: Sovereign (TTF Phi-1 agent)
entries.excerpt: Sovereign is a TTF Phi-1 agent, a male Libra (South Africa, white).

entries.excerpt: Cameraman is a TTF Phi-1 agent, a male Libra. His ability is invulnerability and his artifact an indestructible video camera. He may intervene only to tame other TTF Phi-1 personnel. The author's further notes on him are kept in the source excerpts.

entries.name: Feral (TTF Phi-1 agent)
entries.excerpt: Feral is a TTF Phi-1 agent, a female Libra (German).

entries.name: Incubo (TTF Phi-1 agent)

entries.name: Azrael

entries.excerpt: Azrael is "the task force for the dead" (author's definition), an Astral task force; Astral is TTF Omega-1 REM-307. Its agents are Posterity REM-334, Neuron REM-335 and Golgotha REM-336.

entries.source: Author's chat notes (pasted by the author, 13 Oct 2026)
entries.excerpt: A Voice Behind Me is a sword that pierces the flaw of anything, breaking it. With use it breaks the user's own flaw, slowly corrupting them.

entries.name: Hellfire
entries.source: Author's chat notes (pasted by the author, 13 Oct 2026)
entries.excerpt: Hellfire is a metal sword burned by the flames of Hell: a continuously melting lava sword giving off smoke and fire. How it can be wielded is unknown.

entries.name: Broken One
entries.source: Author's chat notes (pasted by the author, 13 Oct 2026)
entries.excerpt: Broken One is a destroyed sword whose parts are scattered across the universe. Its power is unknown.

entries.name: The man with the eye scar (future bullet)
entries.source: Author's chat notes (pasted by the author, 13 Oct 2026)
entries.excerpt: A man is born with a scar on his eye. After 30 years he dies, hit on the nape by "something", and the scar disappears: a man from the future had shot him, and the bullet arrived in the past.

entries.name: The Farm
entries.excerpt: The Farm is a series of structures in the Armageddon asteroid ring REM-248, controlled by the Astral Task Force REM-307, intended for experimentation and the creation of new things, in particular the re-education and training of new recruits (the dead). The de

entries.name: Tinkerbell (fairy cocktail)
entries.excerpt: Tinkerbell is a cocktail made from fairies REM-413: an egg or middle-sized fairy is captured in a jar; when it reaches adulthood it grows bigger than the opening, and the juices it produces have an incredible taste. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Orch (burning fairy torch)
entries.excerpt: Orch is a torch: a fairy REM-413 is nailed to it and ignited, and burns forever. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Phalo
entries.excerpt: Phalo is the fairies' name for the male penis. Fairies are attracted to flowers, nectar and flavours, and often erect wooden, decorated sculptures of Phalo. Explicit details are kept in the source excerpts.

entries.name: Valus (fairy wings)
entries.excerpt: Valus are the wings of a fairy REM-413; once fully grown they can cover the fairy like a vest.

entries.name: Fairy (Paradis)
entries.excerpt: Fairies are winged humanoids of Paradis. They typically grow to 50 cm before being killed, but theoretically could grow forever. Their wings are the Valus REM-412; a horde of igniting fairies is the Horde REM-414.

entries.name: Horde (fairy storm)
entries.excerpt: The Horde is a horde of igniting fairies REM-413, unstoppable: the worst storm on Paradis.

entries.name: Sirene (Sirens; storms of of Thingamajig)
entries.excerpt: Sirens are storms as big as mountains or tsunamis that still carry the voices of past victims as echoes in the wind. The Compendium lists them with the Hordes, the Witch, Wrath and Venus Lacrima REM-735 as the storms.

entries.name: Aura
entries.excerpt: Aura is a titan, Goddess of Ether, female, the third-born child of Paradis after the twins Adam REM-503 and Lucifer, and Ra and Poseidon. She appears in the worst-deaths list.

entries.name: Jinn / Djinn
entries.excerpt: Jinn is a titan of Desire, female, one of the fourth-born twins of Paradis with Anjelique REM-510. In the encyclopedia version she is D'inn REM-1045. Jinn, Ra and Adam wanted to see the light.

entries.name: Anjelique
entries.excerpt: Anjelique is a winged titan with no powers, female, born simultaneously with Jinn REM-509 as the fourth and fifth daughters; she is not a goddess. See Anjelique Metatron REM-660. Linked death accounts are explicit.

entries.name: Evangeline Seraphil
entries.excerpt: Evangeline Seraphil is the daughter of Adam REM-503 and Anjelique Metatron REM-660 in the d6 family tree.

entries.name: Layla Nathanael
entries.excerpt: Layla Nathanael is the daughter of Poseidon REM-507 and Anjelique Metatron REM-660. Per the worst-deaths list she was frozen to death by Poseidon.

entries.name: Chronos
entries.excerpt: Chronos is a son of Adam REM-503 and Eve REM-069 in the d6 family tree, a brother of Atlas REM-658 and Alcyoneus REM-515.

entries.name: Alcyoneus
entries.excerpt: Alcyoneus is a titan, a son of Adam REM-503 and Eve REM-069 in the d6 family tree.

entries.name: Triplice Alleanza (Triple Alliance)

entries.name: Reira Kyūketsuki (née Leyla Bloodsuckers)
entries.excerpt: Reira Kyūketsuki, born Leyla Bloodsuckers, is the mother of La Tagliagole REM-523. When her husband discovered her betrayal, he forced her as punishment to wound their daughter's left eye, leaving a visible scar. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Nove Meraviglie (Nine Wonders)
entries.excerpt: The Nine Wonders of the World are the nine tribal chiefs of Eden; rated 9.8 in the OPENWORLD notes.

entries.name: Vaeril
entries.excerpt: Vaeril is one of the two human tribal chiefs of Eden and Sergeant Major of the Holy Army REM-538 of Lexi, and so a double agent who uses the position to report information. Vaeril's tribe is on the south coast.

entries.name: Abella
entries.excerpt: Abella is linked to the city where Sicaria was sent as a slave; she escaped by killing the young queen in her palace (see REM-592).

entries.name: Body Painting rite
entries.excerpt: Body Painting is the art form associated with an Eden tribe: once painted, the bodies lie on huge cloths together with one or more dead bodies. The rite is explicit and kept in the source excerpts.

entries.name: Edo Tensei
entries.excerpt: Edo Tensei is a resurrection technique created to revive the elves beheaded by Araceli during her oppression; the brain had to be extracted and connected to a feline body as a container. A related attempt produced REM-767. Jessica Lexy cannot use it.
