entries.name: Impero Orientale (Eastern Empire, Utopya)
entries.excerpt: The Eastern Empire is located in the Earthly Paradise, Utopya. Its most skilful and fearless warrior is Selussa, born in the Lexi Empire and sent against it at five as punishment; Selussa survived 15 years in desolate northern Utopya, then joined the Eastern E

entries.name: Triplice Impero (Triple Empire)
entries.excerpt: The Triple Empire's army is the Triple Alliance REM-519, rated 10.0.

entries.name: Tenebrosa
entries.excerpt: Tenebrosa is a region of the Desolate Land REM-520 in the OPENWORLD notes, listed with the Twenty-billions Deadly Sins REM-516.

entries.name: Feline (Felines)
entries.excerpt: Felines are the most numerous creatures of Eden: part of the spell to resurrect the elves worked, while the other part moved onto felines, making them human-like. Listed among the wild animals with mariannes and centauresses. Explicit details are kept in the s

entries.name: Centaure (Centauresses)
entries.excerpt: Centauresses originate in the Desolate Lands; only one group moved to Eden. Their bodies are equine from just below the knees. Explicit anatomical details are kept in the source excerpts.

entries.name: Embioptera (webspinners)
entries.excerpt: The Embioptera (webspinners) of this world spin remarkably resistant webs that serve as the elves' houses, because the elves' religion forbids damaging the forest, so they cannot cut trees.

entries.name: Olaurae
entries.excerpt: Olaurae is a tribal chief of Eden who lives with Mirabanise REM-582 and Orìfice REM-583; their tribes are so close they seem one tribe.

entries.name: Mirabanise
entries.excerpt: Mirabanise is a tribal chief of Eden who lives with Olaurae REM-581 and Orìfice REM-583; their tribes are so close they seem one tribe.

entries.name: Orìfice
entries.excerpt: Orìfice is a tribal chief of Eden who lives with Olaurae REM-581 and Mirabanise REM-582; their tribes are so close they seem one tribe.

entries.name: Oracle (Eden chief)
entries.excerpt: Oracle is one of the richest tribal chiefs of Eden, with one of the largest dwellings. She is so called because she is the only one able to use magic to predict the future. Her place is around the Sacred Temple REM-1075.

entries.name: Pluto (Arma Ancestrale / Ancestral Weapon)
entries.excerpt: Pluto is an Ancestral Weapon and a recognised tribe of Eden. Its power is the most feared: it can stop the Earth's rotation, sweeping away all peoples. The catalogue notes it is hunted by Angels and Demons.

entries.name: Lei "Succube" (Lei Succubus)
entries.excerpt: Lei "Succubus" is the most experienced Eden chief in combat; this and her appearance recall a succubus, hence the name. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Sperduta (The Lost One)
entries.excerpt: Sperduta (the Lost One) is the only human to survive every attack of the Eden armies in the Black Forest REM-593. Being on the elves' side, she was given command of a tribe.

entries.name: Weapon-X
entries.excerpt: Weapon-X is listed among the important personalities of Eden. No further details are given.

entries.name: Spaventosa (The Frightful)
entries.excerpt: Spaventosa (the Frightful) is listed among the important personalities of Eden, with no main villages. No further details are given.

entries.name: Sicarie (assassin corps)
entries.excerpt: The Sicarie are excellent and ruthless assassins serving Sicaria REM-591, one of the Nine. As a distinctive trait they, Sicaria included, wear only lingerie, a symbol of appropriating the human world. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Sicaria
entries.excerpt: Sicaria is one of the Nine Wonders REM-528, the tribal chiefs of Eden. Sent as a slave to Abella REM-592, she escaped by entering the young queen's palace and killing her, then began wearing her lingerie as mockery. She leads the Sicarie REM-590. Flagged expli

entries.name: Abella (city)
entries.excerpt: Abella is the city where Sicaria was sent as a slave. She escaped by entering the young queen's palace and killing her, then began wearing her lingerie as mockery. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Foresta Nera (Black Forest) / Eden
entries.image_caption: EDEN coat of arms (author's artwork, BANDIERE folder; the same emblem is saved as the Dzhesica Imperii flag)
entries.excerpt: The Black Forest, called Eden by the elves, is named for its numerous internal pitfalls. Elves once lived peacefully with humans; when humans with REM-1018 began attacking them they took refuge in its heart. A being able to control plants through water makes i

entries.name: Mura del Paradiso (Walls of Paradise)
entries.excerpt: The Walls of Paradise are the male elves: their build makes them unagile in Eden's narrow spaces but suited to open-field battle, so they are trained to defend Eden's borders.

entries.name: Hel (Impero Orientale explorer expeditions)
entries.excerpt: Hel is the explorer of the Eastern Empire REM-574 who arrived in Eden with his crew in the Era of Slavery, seeking the source of gravitational distortions detected by compasses: the Breach in Time REM-615, which breaks space-time. The catalogue records that th

entries.name: Era del Vuoto / della Schiavitù / Nuova / Presente (Eden eras)
entries.excerpt: Eden history is divided into four eras: the Era of the Void, the Era of Slavery, the New Era and the Present Era. In the Era of the Void the elves lived in small tribes with huts and rudimentary boats, using weapons only to hunt. Explorers later found that the

entries.name: Monastero dimenticato (Forgotten Monastery)
entries.excerpt: The Forgotten Monastery is an old monastery crushed beneath a huge wreck in pieces. It is followed in the notes by the Story of the Monk.

entries.name: Tempio degli dei (Temple of the Gods)
entries.excerpt: The Temple of the Gods is a large neoclassical temple full of statues, led by a priestess. Her subordinates wear a bandana over their eyes, said to be out of respect for the blind priestess; in reality she is Medusa. See the City of Temples REM-665.

entries.name: Medusa (the blind priestess)
entries.excerpt: Medusa is the blind priestess of the Temple of the Gods REM-598, whose subordinates cover their eyes; the statues of the City of Temples REM-665 are her victims.

entries.name: Seme del Tempo (Seed of Time)
entries.excerpt: The Seed of Time was created and planted by Lucifer REM-504, who wanted the Universe to age and go out completely, returning to the Primordial Darkness REM-602 so that Rangi REM-501 and Papa could reunite. It bore the Fruit of Time REM-601.

entries.name: Frutto del Tempo (Fruit of Time)
entries.excerpt: The Fruit of Time is the fruit Eve REM-069 persuaded Adam REM-503 to eat, which made him age.

entries.name: Oscurità Primordiale (Primordial Darkness)
entries.excerpt: The Primordial Darkness is the state Lucifer REM-504 wanted to return to by ageing the Universe until it went out.

entries.name: Grande Padre (Great Father)
entries.excerpt: The Great Father is the title of Adam REM-503, firstborn of humankind.

entries.name: Madre Primordiale (Primordial Mother)
entries.excerpt: The Primordial Mother is Eve REM-069: able to procreate though her relationship with Adam was aeons ago, she bore children of whom some were mortal and some immortal. She has mouths on her breasts, as a symbol of fertility. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Esercito Immortale (Immortal Army)
entries.excerpt: The Immortal Army is a hundred statues repainted by X REM-611 in later millennia. Thanks to the Ring of Flow REM-606 they can move normally while remaining stopped in time, and so dense as statues.

entries.name: Anello del Flusso (Ring of Flow)
entries.excerpt: The Ring of Flow lets the statues of the Immortal Army REM-605 move normally while remaining stopped in time.

entries.name: Mano di Dio (Hand of God / Hand of X)
entries.excerpt: The Hand of God (Hand of X) is a nebula. When Adam struck the Mother and shattered her, the pieces formed the cosmic material; some nebulae represent the Hand of God, the Eye of Rangi REM-608, the Phantom Nebula REM-609 and some titans.

entries.name: Occhio di Rangi (Eye of God)
entries.excerpt: The Eye of God (Eye of Rangi) is a nebula representing the eye of Rangi REM-501, blinded by a fragment of the Mother when Adam shattered her. Compare the God's Eye nebula REM-1035.

entries.name: Nebulosa fantasma (Phantom Nebula)
entries.excerpt: The Phantom Nebula is one of the nebulae formed from the cosmic material of the shattered Mother, listed with the Hand of God REM-607 and the Eye of Rangi REM-608.

entries.name: Vento (Wind)
entries.excerpt: Wind is Eve's brother. When she lost contact with her body and it suddenly aged into dust, Wind spread the dust across the world, generating what is now called Life: the dust fertilised the Earth, creating plants.

entries.name: X (the god / the Universe)
entries.excerpt: X is the god who creates all the stories in order to understand the Universe. But he is the Universe, so the stories are created, chaotically, to understand himself. The Breach in Time REM-615, opened when Adam killed Lucifer REM-504, is the only reason X can

entries.name: A (the angel-monk)
entries.excerpt: A is an angel who falls in love with B REM-613, a woman. When the angels, following the word of X, agree not to intervene, A opposes them to save her; some angels side with him, but through the Ring of Fear REM-614 they are made terrifying to others. The catal

entries.name: B (the woman / the saint in ice)
entries.excerpt: B is a woman loved by the angel A REM-612. A monastery venerates a saint embalmed in an ice case who is really B, stopped in time; she is visible only through a strange play of light in the ice, and the monks' rule is never to look at her.

entries.name: Anello della paura (Ring of Fear)
entries.excerpt: The Ring of Fear makes the angels who side with A REM-612 appear terrifying to others.

entries.name: Breccia nel Tempo (Breach in Time)
entries.excerpt: The Breach in Time is the cut in time created when Adam REM-503 killed Lucifer REM-504 in a legendary battle. It is the only reason X REM-611 can travel through time. It breaks space-time, generating gravitational anomalies, and now lies about fifty metres ben

entries.name: Foresta dell'Eden
entries.excerpt: The Forest of Eden has grown over the Breach in Time REM-615; over the millennia the environment changed, and the breach now lies about fifty metres beneath the forest.

entries.name: Kaidou, Mulher
entries.excerpt: Mulher Kaidou ("Female"), number 7 in the Bounties of Paradis (bounty 8,800,960,000), from Öý, is the only female Kaidō in history. Flagged explicit.

entries.excerpt: Jessica Lexy Bordeaux ("God beholds"), number 9 in the Bounties of Paradis (career bounty 8,000,000,000), was the last Empress of Tomorrow REM-1002 of the Lexi Empire and the first and only empress of the Confederation of Slavery REM-637. She attempted seppuku

entries.name: Mortuus, Equuleus
entries.excerpt: Equuleus Mortuus ("little horse"), number 10 in the Bounties of Paradis (bounty 8,000,000,000), from Öý, is the strongest rank #2 in the Army of Öý REM-636: a fearsome warrior and the wife of a Kaidou.

entries.name: Eeuende (Bellator of Lexii)
entries.excerpt: Eeuende, number 11 in the Bounties of Paradis, nicknamed Bellator of Lexii, is an Orcus elfus captured and detained, formerly a Screaming Howler REM-555. Her bounty is at least 6,800,000,000 (7,850,000,000 in reality; 9,500,000,000 at the end of the novel).

entries.name: Vilkas, Groyl
entries.excerpt: Groyl Vilkas ("Horror"), number 17 in the Bounties of Paradis (bounty 2,500,000,000), is the Champion of Champions and brother of Amoux Vilkas REM-631: a gruesome, extremely aggressive warrior without remorse, wearing a big belt with a golden face relief.

entries.name: Rodhår, Ulaka
entries.excerpt: Ulaka Rodhår ("Aggressive"), number 19 in the Bounties of Paradis (bounty 800,000,000), is a female Raider of the Army of Öý REM-636, with war paint like three scratches.

entries.name: Kaidou, Sēnṭaura
entries.excerpt: Sēnṭaura Kaidou ("Centaur"), from Öý, was one of the three strongest Kaidous ever, a master of the kyoketsu shoge REM-673. Even unarmed he was considered "stronger than a centaur", though he died at the hands of one. His unarmed style of repeatedly attacking o

entries.name: Vilkai Klan
entries.excerpt: The Vilkai Klan is a werewolf clan based on Lupus homo and Homo vulpes, headed by Vilkai Rodhår REM-628 with Amoux Vilkas REM-631 second in command. Members shapeshift into werewolves at the full moon. The uMvuni Klan is related to it by blood.

entries.name: Army of Öý
entries.excerpt: The Army of Öý includes several bounty holders: Equuleus Mortuus REM-626 and Layla REM-621 (rank #2), Anjelina Rodhår REM-630, the Tamer Lašiša REM-629 and the Raider Ulaka REM-633.

entries.name: Confederation of Slavery
entries.excerpt: The Confederation of Slavery had one empress, its first and only: Jessica Lexy Bordeaux REM-625, last Empress of Tomorrow of the Lexi Empire. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: The Four Horsewomen
entries.excerpt: The Four Horsewomen were the best warriors of the continent of Araceli REM-1018. Members include Layla REM-621, the strongest, also known as the Red Harlot REM-692.

entries.name: Lilith evocation (body-fluid magic)
entries.excerpt: Lilith is the titan most preached and used by magicians. Her body fluids can be evoked, more useful the sicker and denser they are, worn as sentient armour or used to create spider nests; magicians can also evoke parts of her external body. Explicit details ar

entries.name: Homo draco
entries.excerpt: Homo draco is the son of Lilith and Poseidon: a dragon able to shapeshift into a humanoid with amphibian traits, such as an extremely long tongue and a soft but dense body under the scales.

entries.name: Succubus (Orcus elfus × Lilith)
entries.excerpt: Succubi are born from Lilith and an Orcus elfus: elf-like females with tails and wings. Their offspring with a Homo torus are Succubae draenei REM-642. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Succubae draenei
entries.excerpt: Succubae draenei are the offspring of a Succubus REM-641 and a Homo torus: nearly identical to Succubi but sometimes wingless, with torus-like legs sometimes furred like a faun's. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Jasmine (a jinn)
entries.excerpt: Jasmine, first in a strength-ranked list in the Bounties of Paradis, is a jinn surrounded by golden chains, able to grant any of her master's wishes.

entries.name: Planetaria
entries.excerpt: Planetaria, second in the ranked list, is a silicon-based carnivorous plant living in deep space. Depending on its prey, it evolves an avatar of the prey's deepest sexual desire to attract it. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Bel (amphibian succubus)
entries.excerpt: Bel, third in the ranked list, is an amphibian succubus with a long tongue. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Capo delle Bestie (Chief of Beasts / King of Beasts)
entries.excerpt: The Chief (King) of Beasts is the male King of the Lands REM-560. To prove himself strongest he must kill an elephant seal bare-handed in the King's Trial REM-675. He strangled La Tagliagole REM-523 one-handed after disarming her in two moves, and was badly in

entries.name: Domatrice di orso delle caverne (Cave-bear tamer)
entries.excerpt: The cave-bear tamer is a unit of the Berserkers in the army list of the Lands.

entries.name: Guardie Reali (2 armed Gigantopithecus)
entries.excerpt: The Royal Guards are two armed Gigantopithecus in the Berserker army list.

entries.name: Anisodon (Chalicothere knights)
entries.excerpt: Anisodon is the unit of four Chalicothere knights in the Berserker army list; West and East Anisodon are also warrior ranks (see REM-1014, REM-1015). Flagged explicit through linked material.

entries.name: Frecce Alate (Winged Arrows)
entries.excerpt: The Winged Arrows are nine Quetzalcoatlus knights in the Berserker army list.

entries.name: Ingordi (The Greedy)
entries.excerpt: The Greedy are fifty hippopotamus knights in the Berserker army list.

entries.name: Barbari (Barbarians)
entries.excerpt: The Barbarians are ninety moose knights in the Berserker army list.

entries.name: Bruti (Brutes)
entries.excerpt: The Brutes are 350,000 infantry in the Berserker army list.

entries.name: Armata del Paradiso (Army of Paradise)
entries.excerpt: The Army of Paradise is the army of Eden, about 1,175 warriors (827 legendary, 300 grand, 48 qualified), including the Sicarie and 27 Screaming Warriors REM-555. Mediocre in the open field, it is unbeatable when attacked inside Eden, even by all other armies t

entries.name: Armata dell'Oracolo (Army of the Oracle)
entries.excerpt: The Army of the Oracle numbers about 154 warriors: 15 legendary and 139 qualified.

entries.name: Impero di Lexi army (ca. 32,230)
entries.excerpt: The army of the Lexi Empire numbers about 32,230 warriors: 50 legendary, 100 grand and 32,080 qualified, with ranks including Mages, Pirates and Honourable Legends.

entries.name: Atlante (Atlas)
entries.excerpt: Atlas (Atlante) is a titan, son of Adam REM-503 and Eve REM-069 in the d6 family tree. His sons, the Atlanthideus REM-688, were drowned by Poseidon REM-507 while trying to escape to another continent (see REM-659).

entries.name: Sons of Atlante
entries.excerpt: The Sons of Atlante, the Atlanthideus REM-688, were drowned by Poseidon REM-507 while trying to escape to another continent.

entries.name: Anjelique Metatron
entries.excerpt: Anjelique Metatron is a titan. In the d6 family tree she is the mother of REM-511 (with Adam), REM-512 (with Hephaestus REM-114) and REM-513 (with Poseidon). In the worldbuilding encyclopedia her daughter by Hephaestus is Jehoel, also called Abaddon, whose exp

entries.name: Papa Tūānuku and Rangi Nui
entries.excerpt: Papa Tūānuku and Rangi Nui are the first line of the Paradis family tree; see Rangi REM-501 and Papa REM-502.

entries.name: Monaco (death of the monk)
entries.excerpt: The monk (Monaco) died crushed by a ship after witnessing his wife's death. The monastery's story must never show it in full until the ship appears, when the whole monastery is framed (see the Forgotten Monastery REM-597).

entries.name: La Tagliagole (death)
entries.excerpt: La Tagliagole REM-523 was strangled to death one-handed by the King of Beasts REM-647 after being disarmed in two moves. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Battle of the Four Kingdoms
entries.excerpt: The Battle of the Four Kingdoms is where the Chief of Beasts REM-647 was badly injured, trampled by a herd of horses.

entries.name: Città dei templi (City of Temples)
entries.excerpt: The City of Temples is full of statues, and only one priestess lives there; in reality she is Medusa and the statues are her victims. Medusa is described with long, thin snake braids.

entries.name: Lexy (capital of the Empire)
entries.excerpt: Lexy is the capital of the Empire. Its huge royal palace, the Sakura Palace REM-667, is separated from the rest of the city by a moat and reachable only by bridges above the city.

entries.name: Palazzo Sakura (Lexy royal palace)
entries.excerpt: The Sakura Palace is the huge royal palace of Lexy REM-666, separated from the city by a moat and reachable only by bridges. See also REM-701.

entries.name: Tunica-ali (robe that becomes wings)
entries.excerpt: A robe that becomes wings, "like Big Chill", is an item idea for the monk's story.

entries.name: Coso delle marionette (puppet controller)
entries.excerpt: The puppet controller is an item idea: a device to control beings, like Sasori's in Huntik.

entries.name: Dieci anelli (Ten Rings)
entries.excerpt: The Ten Rings are an item idea in the notes ("see ten rings").

entries.name: Legendary shield (Adamo)
entries.excerpt: The Legendary Shield is an item idea: a giant's head forged or made into a shield, dullahan-style, associated with Adam REM-503.

entries.name: Armatura vivente (Living Armour)
entries.excerpt: The Living Armour is an item idea in the notes: "exactly that".

entries.name: Kyotetsu shoge (weapon)
entries.excerpt: The kyoketsu shoge is the weapon named after its maker Kyoketsu Shoge REM-618, the single most dangerous weapon ever created; Sēnṭaura Kaidou REM-634 mastered it. Flagged explicit through linked material.

entries.name: Guerrieri leggendari (Legendary Warriors)
entries.excerpt: The Legendary Warriors are a hundred immortal warriors commanded by the man with half his face in darkness; the notes link them to Eve.

entries.name: Prova del Re (King's Trial)
entries.excerpt: The King's Trial is the final test of the king of the Lands: after killing an elk bare-handed and taming hippopotami, Quetzalcoatlus, chalicotheres and cave bears, he must prove himself strongest by killing an elephant seal bare-handed, and his clothing is the

entries.name: Armata dei Berserkers (Berserker Army)
entries.excerpt: The Berserker Army is the most feared army in the world, about 350,157 warriors: 157 legendary and 350,000 front-line. Its units include the Royal Guards REM-649, Anisodon REM-650, Winged Arrows REM-651, the Greedy REM-652, Barbarians REM-653 and Brutes REM-65

entries.name: Taxonomy size ladder (lyviathan → lice)
entries.excerpt: A grouped reference row: a size scale of real animals for Paradis, ordered "from bigger to smaller", from the leviathan down to lice.

entries.name: VLTRA (galaxy / three-star system)
entries.excerpt: VLTRA is a galaxy with a three-star system: Hel REM-679, Lux REM-680 and Aeterna REM-681.

entries.name: Hel (star)
entries.excerpt: Hel is the primary star of the VLTRA REM-678 system. No further detail is given in this source.

entries.name: Lux (star)
entries.excerpt: Lux is a star of the VLTRA REM-678 system, of mass 0.4.

entries.name: Aeterna (star)
entries.excerpt: Aeterna is a star of the VLTRA REM-678 system, of mass 0.5.

entries.name: Primaria (star)
entries.excerpt: Primaria is a star of the 02 system in the VLTRA notes REM-678.

entries.name: Secunda (star)
entries.excerpt: Secunda is a star of the 02 system in the VLTRA notes REM-678.

entries.name: Eden (planet)
entries.excerpt: Eden is a planet in the VLTRA notes REM-678, at 2.08 AU, the same distance as Paradis.

entries.name: Paradis constructed language (articles Yul / Yula, pronouns Ay, Y'u…)
entries.excerpt: The Paradis constructed language has articles Yul/Yula and pronouns such as Ay and Y'u. Its pronunciation mixes American English, Kiwi, Patois, and Brazilian and European Portuguese.

entries.name: Slavery (lexicon) — Chaining, Banquetting, Strapping
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: Slavery, in the encyclopedia's lexicon, is a market based on owning someone's life, usually with the owner controlling movement. Practices include Chaining (blocking movement with chains), Banquetting (one chain from neck and legs to an immovable object such a

entries.name: Piercing / Bubbling / Cowing (lexicon)
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: Piercing, in the lexicon, is piercing the body with metals; originally a slavery practice, it merged into popular culture, most commonly on the nipples and ears. Bubbling, Cowing and the Rings, Gemini and Squared Rings variants are explicit and kept in the sou

entries.name: Atlanthideus (sons of Atlante)
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: The Atlanthideus ("from Atlante") are the sons of Atlas REM-658, drowned to death by Poseidon REM-507 (see REM-659).

entries.name: Phutha Clan
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: The Phutha Clan ("Clan of Pitch") has members all over the world between the Lexi Empire and the Hel Empire REM-1033, with visibly pitch-black hair. Its best-known member is Dorei Phutha REM-690.

entries.name: Phutha, Dorei
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: Dorei Phutha ("Soil") of the Phutha Clan REM-689 is the most notorious prostitute in the world, living in the Hel Empire REM-1033; so rich she wears only jewellery.

entries.name: Bloodsuckers Clan
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: The Bloodsuckers Clan is the second most notorious clan of Araceli REM-1018 and the most feared in the world. Almost all its members are dead, and the rest are mostly hunted.

entries.name: The Red Harlot (Layla Bloodsuckers)
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: The Red Harlot is the name by which Layla Bloodsuckers REM-621 is remembered. Abandoned as a baby and raised by the Vilkai Klan REM-635, she was the first female warrior to reach the West Anisodon REM-1015 and East Anisodon REM-1014 ranks. When the previous Ka

entries.name: Bordeaux Clan
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: The Bordeaux Clan is related by blood to the Bloodsuckers but does not have red hair; the name refers only to the relation. Members include Jessica Lexy REM-625 and Lancillotto REM-622. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Sir Lancillotto / Sire Maniac
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: Sir Lancillotto, or Sire Maniac, is the common name of Lancillotto Bordeaux REM-622, the sadistic prince and collector of the City of Love, who captured Furia Jehoel, the near-perfect copy of Abaddon Jehoel REM-512.

entries.name: City of Love
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: The City of Love is where Sir Lancillotto REM-622, a sadistic prince who collects exotic beings, resided.

entries.name: Demiurge Clan
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: The Demiurge Clan ("Clan of Creators") is an ancient clan that prospered in the Age of the Gods REM-1031; every member can create anything from nothing. Members include Jelena REM-697 and Lašiša REM-629. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Demiurge, Jelena ("The Monster")
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: Jelena Demiurge ("Torch"), nicknamed "The Monster", is an Airman. She lives with an apparent illness that is actually her clan's power: her cells multiply chaotically, changing her genes. The explicit result is kept in the source excerpts.

entries.name: Jehoel Clan
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: The Jehoel Clan includes Abaddon REM-512, Furia and Melyssa. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Djesica (Jessica)
entries.excerpt: Djesica (Jessica) is the namesake of the "Empire of Jessica" REM-753, an erotopian, all-women society based on socialism and meritocracy, formally governed by its founder-emperor under the Codex REM-754. Related figures named Jessica Lexy appear in the Bountie

entries.name: Sakura Palace
entries.excerpt: The Sakura Palace (similar to the Grosse Halle) is the centre of a city built like Babylonian hanging gardens on a single level. Inside, in front of the entrance, stand a colossal naked statue of the goddess Hathor REM-112 and a gigantic bathhouse.

entries.name: Dominus
entries.excerpt: "Dominus" is recorded in the character chart as the word the character overuses. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Llaurentio
entries.excerpt: Llaurentio is the first name given in a character chart. In the Laws of Paradise, the Sacred Temple REM-1075 is home to the legendary Rebel of the Eastern Empire, Llaurentio, who rejects his motherland as unable to bring peace and seeks a utopia of total peace

entries.name: The Basilisk (Brains of the Basilisk)
entries.excerpt: The Basilisk appears in a monologue in which the speaker, Orpheus REM-000, says he is a necessary being for the universe to exist "since I am the de facto Brains of the Basilisk", omnipresent, omniscient and omnipotent, his own demiurge.

entries.name: LIA-579
entries.excerpt: LIA-579 is a coded name in the worldbuilding character-name list, based on Akali.

entries.name: Divine cells (microscopic worms)
entries.excerpt: Divine cells: the notes state that the "lumps (divine cells) are actually microscopic worms".

entries.name: Fauna lists (elongated bodies; birds incl. gryphon)
entries.excerpt: A grouped reference row of real-species lists for Paradis: animals with elongated bodies (diggers such as the mole crab, Mexican mole lizard, mole cricket, naked mole rat and star-nosed mole) and birds, including the bellbird and the gryphon.

entries.name: Diana (GODS)
entries.excerpt: Diana is listed under GODS in the worldbuilding character-name list; the catalogue notes she is based on Wonder Woman. A researcher Diana appears in the Hollow of Lily account. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Samantha Magnifique
entries.excerpt: Samantha Magnifique is a magician in the worldbuilding character-name list, based on the Witch from Goblin Slayer.

entries.name: Jean Magnifique / Queen of Miroirs
entries.excerpt: Jean Magnifique, Queen of Miroirs, is a magician in the worldbuilding character-name list, based on Jean Grey.

entries.name: Vanessa Beidou
entries.excerpt: Vanessa Beidou is a human in the worldbuilding character-name list, based on Beidou (Genshin Impact).

entries.name: Chanceux Beidou
entries.excerpt: Chanceux Beidou is a human in the worldbuilding character-name list, based on Miss Fortune.

entries.name: Inshitsu Kaze
entries.excerpt: Inshitsu Kaze is a human in the worldbuilding character-name list, based on Chun-Li.

entries.name: Lily Belle

entries.name: Diana Vertueux
entries.excerpt: Diana Vertueux is a human in the worldbuilding character-name list, based on Lara Croft.

entries.name: Daphne Vertueux
entries.excerpt: Daphne Vertueux is a human in the worldbuilding character-name list, based on Claire Dearing.

entries.name: Amethista Fleurhana

entries.name: Fou Fleurhana

entries.name: Maelstrom A (galaxy)
entries.excerpt: Maelstrom A is a small spiral galaxy of 29,000 light years, a parody of Sagittarius A. The Hel system REM-278 lies in its galactic habitable zone, about 14,500 light years from the central black hole. The nearest star is Ander Ster REM-149, 4.57 light years aw

entries.name: Hel Nebulae
entries.excerpt: The Hel Nebulae is the giant molecular cloud whose partial collapse formed the star Hel 3.5 billion years ago; the planet Paradis REM-500 formed about 100 million years later.

entries.name: Ander Reus (gas giant)
entries.excerpt: Ander Reus (Afrikaans for "distant other") is an outer planet of the Hel system, a gas giant with accretion disks.

entries.name: Venus Lacrima
entries.excerpt: Venus Lacrima (Latin, "tears of Venus") is an outer planet of the Hel system, an ice giant with storms and rains of glass.

entries.name: L. Nero (the author's pseudonym)
entries.excerpt: L. Nero is the author's pseudonym, quoted in Djesica Imperii: "This canvas is where the author imagined their work, with their meta power manipulation."

entries.name: Succy
entries.excerpt: Succy is a red-haired woman who shapeshifts into her demonic form with pleasure: elf ears, four brown horns, cephalopod eyes, a tail and pinkish skin. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Diviners
entries.excerpt: Diviners are the scariest and most dangerous magicians: through logograms they hold vast knowledge, especially of the future. Using linguistic relativity, they summarise past and present events in symbols and then a single logogram, from which they predict pat

entries.name: Enchanters
entries.excerpt: Enchanters are magicians with little knowledge of logograms who reach the supercritical emotion, lust, through sexual practices; masters of their craft, "real cheaters". They invented arousal drugs such as Enchantress Touch REM-742, the Hucow Formula REM-743 a

entries.name: Monks (Djesica)
entries.excerpt: Monks reach the low state through meditation rather than hypnosis. Often experts in combat and spying, they live in temples writing logograms all day and are usually disciples of diviners REM-739, or secret disciples of enchanters.

entries.name: Enchantress Touch
entries.excerpt: Enchantress Touch was among the first drugs introduced in Djesica Imperii, made to stimulate hormones and enhance erogenous sensation. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Hucow Formula
entries.excerpt: The Hucow Formula is an elixir for breast expansion via the mammary glands, invented by enchanters REM-740. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Slave Formula
entries.excerpt: The Slave Formula is a drug that numbs parts of the brain, first made by enchanters to reach the lustful state; some women use it to feel life's burdens less. Because users lack certain cognitive functions, many are prone to enslavement, and the slave market i

entries.name: Dream Soup
entries.excerpt: Dream Soup is a drug for reaching peacefulness (a low, neutral-mood trance): it makes the user fall asleep with eyes open and have lucid dreams.

entries.name: Nyotaimori (restaurant role)
entries.excerpt: Nyotaimori is a restaurant role in Djesica Imperii: women served with food and drinks over their bodies. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Sexcort
entries.excerpt: Sexcort is a role in Djesica Imperii: delivering orders, including food, drinks and sexual activities, to the customer's house. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Bedwarmer
entries.excerpt: Bedwarmer is a role in Djesica Imperii: warming customers with their naked bodies at night. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Catfight arenas (mijuwanijuwakæijuwa)
entries.excerpt: Catfight arenas (mijuwanijuwakæijuwa) are places of public erotic grappling between two or more competitors. The explicit details are kept in the source excerpts.

entries.name: Horror birds (Stymphalian birds)
entries.excerpt: Horror birds are Djesica Imperii's version of the Stymphalian birds: flightless terror birds with metal beaks and feathers.

entries.name: Cerberus (Djesica)
entries.excerpt: The Keeper dog is Djesica Imperii's Cerberus: three twin dogs born fused in one body with three heads (the snakes are omitted). Flagged explicit through linked material.

entries.name: Jörmurgand / Grootslang (Titanoboa)
entries.excerpt: Jörmungandr and Grootslang are, in Djesica Imperii, simply a Titanoboa. Lucifer REM-504 is noted as a deceased titanoboa skeleton.

entries.name: Dzhesika Imperii (the nation)
entries.image_caption: Flag of the Dzhesika Imperii (author's artwork; Drive file "Dzhesica Imperii flag.png")
entries.excerpt: Dzhesika Imperii, the "Empire of Jessica", is an erotopian society of women only, based on socialism and meritocracy and formally governed by its founder-emperor, who created the Codex REM-754. Its institutions include brothels and catfight arenas REM-749, and

entries.name: The Codex
entries.excerpt: The Codex is the law of Dzhesika Imperii REM-753, created by the founder-emperor; its first five articles cannot be modified in any way. It begins with the individual's right to freedom from birth, so long as it does not interfere with another's.

entries.name: Iron Dome
entries.excerpt: The Iron Dome protects the nation of Djesica Imperii REM-753; in foreign politics, its army exists only for self-defence.

entries.name: Omnism / Ether / Totality
entries.excerpt: Omnism, Ether and Totality are entries in the religion table of Djesica Imperii. Linked passages are explicit.

entries.name: Il Pazzo (The Madman)
entries.excerpt: The Madman (character 5) of the philosophical novel TEDIO is not really mad: he has understood the truth and left ignorance, while the others remained in it and see him as mad because he is outside the ordinary. He always rides the tram REM-761, motionless; at

entries.name: L'avvocato (The Lawyer)
entries.excerpt: The Lawyer (character 6) of the philosophical novel TEDIO manipulates reality at will.

entries.name: Il killer (Romanzo filosofico / TEDIO)
entries.excerpt: The Killer (character 7) of the philosophical novel TEDIO: at the end, the madman REM-757, or fake madman, kills all the passengers, tired of their inability to understand Reality, and justifies it by pretending to be mad, becoming what others thought he was.

entries.name: Il barbone (The Tramp; Romanzo filosofico / TEDIO)
entries.excerpt: The Tramp (character 8) of the philosophical novel TEDIO represents a man "who has lived": wise, but having lost everything by following his own thought.

entries.name: The tram (Romanzo filosofico / TEDIO)
entries.excerpt: The tram that runs from the station to the city centre in the philosophical novel TEDIO always carries a madman: not one who screams or acts strangely, but one who is always motionless.

entries.name: The newlywed couple (Romanzo filosofico / TEDIO)
entries.excerpt: The newlywed couple travelled by tram in TEDIO while waiting to buy a new car; since the wife mysteriously died, only the man remained.

entries.name: Personaggi 1–4 (subjective/objective views, sceptic and anti-sceptic passengers)
aliases: objective views, sceptic and anti-sceptic passengers
entries.excerpt: Characters 1–4 of the philosophical novel TEDIO are abstract: the subjective point of view, the objective point of view, and sceptic and anti-sceptic passengers; the catalogue notes they are all the same person.

entries.name: Cleopatra
entries.excerpt: Cleopatra is the Empress of the Eastern Empire REM-574, known as the most beautiful woman of Utopya, with fuchsia hair and a thin crown; certainly the most cultured woman in Utopya and probably the world.

entries.name: Selussa
entries.excerpt: Selussa is the most skilful and feared warrior of the Eastern Empire REM-574. Born in the Lexi Empire and sent against the Eastern Empire at five as punishment for rebelling against slavery, she survived 15 years in desolate northern Utopya, then joined the Ea

entries.name: Aai Sili o le Vaitafe (capital)
entries.excerpt: Aai Sili o le Vaitafe is the capital of REM-521 and REM-522.

entries.name: Mariannes (Eden)
entries.excerpt: Mariannes come from a partly successful attempt to resurrect the elves killed by Araceli REM-1018, with side effects: brains that mould liquid bodies, averaging 170 cm. They can extend their nervous system through water. Their later stages are Ivy and Poison I

entries.name: Djinn (Jessica's race)
entries.excerpt: Djinn is given as the race of Jessica Lexy Bordeaux in her character chart.

entries.name: Tiranno (The Tyrant)
entries.excerpt: The Tyrant leads the Twilighters REM-771, who are himself at different moments in time. He wants to return the Rebels REM-772 to their original dimension, considering their exodus against nature. Time travel has damaged him badly, but he is robotically modifie

entries.name: Crepuscolari (Twilighters)
entries.excerpt: The Twilighters (Crepuscolari) are the Tyrant REM-770 himself at different moments in time, led by him.

entries.name: Ribelli (The Rebels)
entries.excerpt: The Rebels live in a dystopian future and decided to travel to the past to change events, so that they can live in a dimension where their future is positive. Members include Esmeralda REM-773, Be. REM-774 and Lala REM-775.

entries.name: Esmeralda (amata)
entries.excerpt: Esmeralda ("beloved") is one of the Rebels REM-772. She wears only a black hat with a skull and has a stylised heart tattoo on her left cheek. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Be.
entries.excerpt: Be. is one of the Rebels REM-772: she wears only a coat and sometimes boots, always carries a bottle of alcohol and is always drunk. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Lala (bambola / doll)
entries.excerpt: Lala ("doll") is one of the Rebels REM-772, continually subjected to drugs that keep her enslaved. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Bella (android)
entries.excerpt: Bella is an android in the future worldbuilding notes: blonde, almost always in a doctor costume or other cosplay. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Rośa (android)
entries.excerpt: Rośa is an android in the future worldbuilding notes, red-haired, with a piercing in the middle of her lips.

entries.name: "Il Lupo / The Wolf" (Lexy warrior)
entries.excerpt: The Wolf is a warrior of Lexy held prisoner, tied and imprisoned in the non-dystopian future about two hundred years earlier. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Fairy Tales (fan fiction)
entries.excerpt: Fairy Tales is a fan-fiction collection. The Pastures in the Sky sheet lists its characters as Saints: Hana, an unnamed warrior REM-866, Mother Nature REM-840, King Art Hur REM-867 and Queen Muse REM-843. It includes the story of Zoro REM-833 and Hiyori REM-83

entries.name: SHISEI SHIPPUDEN (Naruto fan fiction)
entries.excerpt: SHISEI SHIPPUDEN is a Naruto fan fiction in which Sasuke is dead, Danzo is revived and the New Anbu is born, with Sakura, Shikamaru Nara REM-860, Naruto Uzumaki REM-861, Sai and Tenten among its members.

entries.name: The Singer (narrator in the emerald green dress)
aliases: narrator in the emerald green dress
entries.excerpt: The Singer is the narrator of an explicit erotic prose poem, wearing "this emerald green dress". The text is kept in the source excerpts.

entries.name: Orgy of Flesh
entries.excerpt: Orgy of Flesh is a report in which TTF Alpha-1 REM-310 is dispatched to a sealed Victorian-era structure connected with the aristocracy to report on conditions inside. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Narrator of Hourglass (swordsman)
entries.source: An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams
entries.excerpt: The narrator of An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams is a first-person swordsman who learned the way of the sword in Wanokuni REM-823 under Master Kiku REM-805. He travelled the world for years to grow stronger, built connections with Vegapunk REM-818 and Germa 66

entries.name: Master Kiku
entries.source: An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams
entries.excerpt: Master Kiku is the narrator's comrade and master from Wanokuni REM-823: tall and slender like a dancer, kind and gentle but intimidating, with a deep, soft voice. He ate the kami kami no mi, making him a paper man who scouts with origami.

entries.name: Reiju
entries.source: An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams
entries.excerpt: Reiju is a woman with tattooed thighs in the narrator's crew in An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Bakara
entries.source: An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams
entries.excerpt: Bakara is the narrator's "beloved" and foe in An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams, a fan fiction narrated by a swordsman REM-804; under his Conqueror's Haki she serves as a defensive wall with her own body. The scenes are explicit and kept in the source excerpts.

entries.name: Ruler of the mink tribe
entries.source: An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams
entries.excerpt: The ruler of the mink tribe was slashed by the narrator by mistake instead of Kiku in An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams, a fan fiction narrated by a swordsman REM-804. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Charlotte Amande
entries.source: An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams
entries.excerpt: Charlotte Amande, commander and swordswoman, attacks the narrator in An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams, a fan fiction narrated by a swordsman REM-804. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Shere (former Captain Kuro)
entries.source: An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams
entries.excerpt: Shere, the former Captain Kuro, wields diamond-bladed gloves in An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams, a fan fiction narrated by a swordsman REM-804; the neko neko no mi lets him become a cat-man able to pass through tiny slits. He lands a Kamusari REM-827.

entries.name: Azael (former Wyper)
entries.source: An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams
entries.excerpt: Azael, the former Wyper, is an eater of the hito hito no mi, model: lunaria, in An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams, a fan fiction narrated by a swordsman REM-804. He fights with a haki-coated bazooka and Tiadragon REM-826.

entries.name: Apollo (former Gem)
entries.source: An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams
entries.excerpt: Apollo, the former Gem, is an opponent in An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams, a fan fiction narrated by a swordsman REM-804 who attacks with powerful punches.

entries.name: Captain Kuzan
entries.source: An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams
entries.excerpt: Captain Kuzan is on the island with his fiancée Monet REM-814 in An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams, a fan fiction narrated by a swordsman REM-804, confirmed as one of those shaking the navy system.

entries.name: Monet
entries.source: An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams
entries.excerpt: Monet is Captain Kuzan's REM-813 fiancée in An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams, a fan fiction narrated by a swordsman REM-804.

entries.name: Guernica
entries.source: An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams
entries.excerpt: Guernica is overheard on a call with the fleet admiral in An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams, a fan fiction narrated by a swordsman REM-804.

entries.name: Issho
entries.source: An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams
entries.excerpt: Issho is said to be coming to destroy the island after the narrator's capture in An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams, a fan fiction narrated by a swordsman REM-804.

entries.name: Vander Decker
entries.source: An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams
entries.excerpt: Vander Decker is ready to set sail for the escape in An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams, a fan fiction narrated by a swordsman REM-804.

entries.name: Vegapunk
entries.source: An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams
entries.excerpt: Vegapunk is one of the narrator's connections in An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams, a fan fiction narrated by a swordsman REM-804.

entries.name: Germa 66
entries.source: An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams
entries.excerpt: Germa 66 is one of the narrator's connections in An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams, a fan fiction narrated by a swordsman REM-804.

entries.name: Lazarus (black blade, Supreme Grade Sword)
entries.source: An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams
entries.excerpt: Lazarus is the black blade, one of the Supreme Grade Swords, wielded by the narrator in An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams, a fan fiction narrated by a swordsman REM-804; when he first wielded it, it was a common sword.

entries.name: Cipher Pol
entries.source: An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams
entries.excerpt: Cipher Pol agents, with SWORD REM-822, are said to have been called to the island, shaking the navy system, in An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams, a fan fiction narrated by a swordsman REM-804.

entries.name: SWORD
entries.source: An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams
entries.excerpt: SWORD is said to have been called to the island along with Cipher Pol REM-821 in An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams, a fan fiction narrated by a swordsman REM-804.

entries.name: Wanokuni
entries.source: An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams
entries.excerpt: Wanokuni is where the narrator of a fairy tale learned the way of the sword under Master Kiku REM-805.

entries.name: Shinosesshoku
entries.source: An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams

entries.excerpt: Hiyori, whose courtesan identity is Komurasaki, cares for Zoro REM-833 in the Fairy Tales REM-800, singing to him on cold nights; as Komurasaki she presents a perfect, untouchable illusion. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Flower Capital
entries.excerpt: The Flower Capital is a city in the Fairy Tales. In its grand hall a shamisen melody echoed through the rafters. The immortal warrior Zoro recalled its crowded streets while wandering the desert.

entries.name: The Reaper
entries.excerpt: The Reaper is death in the Fairy Tales REM-800, held at bay by the woman's love when Zoro REM-833's heart stops and he barely survives.

entries.name: Marlin (story)
entries.excerpt: Marlin is a section of the Fairy Tales REM-800, including "The warrior and the geisha", in which she tends the wounded warrior. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Mother Nature (story)
entries.excerpt: Mother Nature is a section of the Fairy Tales REM-800 and is listed as a Saint on the Pastures in the Sky sheet. Linked passages describe her nightly visits to Zoro's body. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Prince Art

entries.name: King Arthur (of Sub)

entries.name: Queen Muse

entries.name: Kingdom of Sub
entries.excerpt: Sub is the kingdom of King Arthur REM-842 and Queen Muse REM-843, whose heir Prince Art REM-841 was raised with an unyielding hand.

entries.name: The Statue (story)

entries.name: Apprehension Engine ("Nightmare Machine")
entries.excerpt: The Apprehension Engine, the "Nightmare Machine", is Mark Korven's instrument; a sample of him improvising on it plays in the background of "Jasper's Theme", whose keyboard imitates a theremin.

entries.name: The forgotten deity

entries.name: BLACKBOXXX (BLACKBOX; Black-Board-of-an-explicit-and-extreme-nature)
entries.excerpt: BLACKBOXXX is a sentient container that stores all data from the paracosm and from the real world, past, present and future. It functions as the "data center" of the Orem and is the afterlife's store of the dead. It is kept in the Library REM-126.

entries.name: Jehoel, Melyssa
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: Melyssa Jehoel ("Honey bee") was part of the Triangulo de la Muerte REM-1087. She died with acid in her mouth. Flagged explicit.

entries.excerpt: Lexi servatoris Imperii ("Lexi saviour of the Empire", usually Lexi Imperii) is the second biggest empire by land and the third biggest territory in the world. For almost all its history it was ruled by an Empress of Tomorrow REM-1002, and it was named after o

entries.name: Empress of Tomorrow
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: Empress of Tomorrow is the title of the empresses who ruled the Lexi Empire REM-1001 for almost all its history. The last was Jessica Lexy Bordeaux REM-625, under whom it became the short-lived Confederation of Slavery REM-637.

entries.name: Ramona Clan; Ramona, Lexy
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: Lexy Ramona, of the Ramona Clan, was the governor of the First Federation REM-1034.

entries.name: Magnes Clan
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: The Magnes Clan ("Magnetic") is the richest clan in the world, based in the Hel Empire REM-1033. It has the biggest slave market in the world and owns Sweet Milk REM-1006. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Sweet Milk
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: Sweet Milk is a business owned by the Magnes Clan REM-1005. The related passage is explicit and kept in the source excerpts.

entries.name: Messor Clan
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: The Messor Clan ("Clan of Reapers") inhabits the cities of Victoria REM-1008 and Lexi.

entries.name: Victoria (city)
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: Victoria is a city inhabited by the Messor Clan REM-1007, the Clan of Reapers, along with Lexi. "Banquetting", chaining a person by neck and legs to an immovable object, is usually seen in the periphery of Victoria, Love and Lexi.

entries.name: Mortuusclan
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: The Mortuusclan ("Clan of Deadmen") inhabited the territories of Öý REM-1011, named for its rituals of reviving the dead to maintain its bloodline. It lasted millennia before being annihilated by the Populus Inferorum REM-1010.

entries.name: Populus Inferorum
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: The Populus Inferorum annihilated the Mortuusclan REM-1009 after millennia.

entries.name: Öý (territory)
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: Öý ("Home") is the biggest territory in the Northern Continent REM-1018.

entries.name: Rodhår Clan
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia

entries.name: Rodhår, Blade
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: Blade Rodhår was the daughter of Araceli Rodhår REM-619, born from a demon.

entries.name: Rodhår, Niji (East Anisodon)
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: Niji Rodhår ("Rainbow") is the East Anisodon. Layla Bloodsuckers REM-621 was the first woman to reach this rank. Flagged explicit through linked material.

entries.name: Rodhår, Senshi (West Anisodon)
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: Senshi Rodhår ("Warrior") is the West Anisodon. Layla Bloodsuckers REM-621 was the first woman to reach this rank.

entries.name: The Birth of Araceli (story)
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: The Birth of Araceli is the most infamous story of the continent: Araceli Rodhår REM-619 single-handedly drove the Devil's Army REM-1017 from the continent by a clever deal.

entries.name: Devil's Army
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: The Devil's Army was driven from the continent by Araceli Rodhår REM-619 through a clever deal, in The Birth of Araceli REM-1016.

entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia

entries.name: Shoge Clan
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: The Shoge Clan ("Clan of Fields") is based in the peripheral territories of the Lexi Empire and specialises in agriculture. Kyoketsu Shoge REM-618 originated the kyoketsu-shoge.

entries.name: Seraphil Clan
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: The Seraphil Clan is the clan of Evangeline Seraphil REM-511. Flagged explicit through linked material.

entries.name: Sicaria tribe
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: The Sicaria tribe is led by a matriarch, the Sicaria ("Killer"), guide of the sicarie REM-590. By tradition she dies with her throat slowly cut by the next Sicaria, using a technique that lets the victim die after about 30 minutes. Flagged explicit.

entries.excerpt: Aries uMvuni is a member of the uMvuni Klan REM-1022, with brown hair and red tattoos. Flagged explicit through linked material.

entries.name: uMvuni, Aquila
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: Aquila uMvuni is a member of the uMvuni Klan REM-1022, with black hair and purple tattoos. Flagged explicit through linked material.

entries.name: uMvuni, Boötes

entries.excerpt: Boötes uMvuni is a member of the uMvuni Klan REM-1022, with blonde hair and blue tattoos. Flagged explicit through linked material.

entries.name: uMvuni, Canis
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: Canis uMvuni is a member of the uMvuni Klan REM-1022, with red hair and blue tattoos. Flagged explicit through linked material.

entries.name: Holy Moon (event)
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: The Holy Moon is the event during which the Vilkai Klan REM-635 attacks the main capital, Lexy, at the end of the Klan's story.

entries.name: Black Continent

entries.name: Age of the Gods

entries.name: Airmen (army rank)

entries.excerpt: The Airmen are the four members of that rank in the most dangerous army in the world; they include Anjelina Rodhår REM-630 and Jelena Demiurge REM-697. Flagged explicit through linked material.

entries.name: Hel Empire
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: The Hel Empire is home to the Magnes Clan REM-1005, owner of the biggest slave market in the world, and to Dorei Phutha REM-690; the Phutha Clan spreads between it and the Lexi Empire.

entries.name: First Federation
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: The First Federation was governed by Lexy Ramona REM-1003.

entries.name: God's Eye nebula
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: The God's Eye nebula is Rangi's REM-501 good eye. When Adam shattered Papa into billions of pieces, one blinded Rangi in one eye, and he keeps watching everything with the other. One piece became Paradis REM-500.

entries.name: Evangeline Jeohel (Seraphil)
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: Evangeline Jeohel (Seraphil) is the daughter of Abaddon REM-512 and Hephaestus, born in the furnace cave. The encyclopedia records that her mother abused her. The passage is explicit and kept in the source excerpts.

entries.name: Crown of thorns (Efesto's gift)
entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: The crown of thorns is a metal crown decorated with dead roses, a gift from Hephaestus that Abaddon REM-512 finds outside the furnace when she decides to leave. When she wears it, blood flows from her head. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Paradis i Hathor (star system)
entries.excerpt: The Paradis i Hathor system ("paradise and goddess of fertility") is a two-body system in which the rocky planet Paradis REM-500, second from Hel, is orbited by its moon Hathor REM-112.

entries.name: Menhir (supreme monolith entity)
entries.excerpt: Menhir ("tall upright stone") is the supreme being of the Paradis i Ander Reus worldbuilding: if observed from beyond reality, the template of things would look like a black monolith in the emptiness of light, or in the impossibility of nothingness. Menhir is

entries.name: Loosipher (snake titan)
entries.excerpt: Loosipher is a snake titan, the asexual God of Flow, in the Paradis i Ander Reus encyclopedia. Hel (death) and Mana (desire) lived embraced for eternity; their first children were the twins Adam, God of Power, and Loosipher. Loosipher plotted to kill Adam. Com

entries.name: Poseiddon (titan)
entries.excerpt: Poseiddon is a titan, God of Seas (electrokinesis), in the Paradis i Ander Reus encyclopedia: twin of Ra REM-1044, born after Adam and Loosipher REM-1042. His weeping for Ra created the seas. Compare Poseidon REM-507.

entries.name: Ra (titan, Goddess of Scorching)
entries.excerpt: Ra is a titan, Goddess of Scorching (fire, lava, plasma), in the Paradis i Ander Reus encyclopedia, twin of Poseiddon REM-1043. Adam melted her spinal cord into a sword (see REM-506). Compare Ra REM-505.

entries.name: D'inn (Goddess of the Unknown)
entries.excerpt: D'inn is the Goddess of the Unknown in the Paradis i Ander Reus encyclopedia. She and Anjel, an intersexual winged titan who is not a goddess and has no powers, were the fourth and fifth daughters, born simultaneously after Aura, Goddess of Ether. The source c

entries.name: The First Day
entries.excerpt: The First Day is the legendary battle in which Adam pierced the body of Loosipher REM-1042 with the Sword of Ra REM-506, creating the breach in time.

entries.name: Nimfs ("God de Nimf")
entries.excerpt: Nimfs ("God de Nimf", "nymphs of God") are the non-cetacean primates and sapient inhabitants of Paradis: bipedal, highly intelligent omnivores with a high metabolism, whose anatomy depends on gender. Mangrove-dwelling nimfs live in tribes led by a matriarch (s

entries.name: Nimf chieftain succession rite
entries.excerpt: Nimf REM-1047 tribes in the mangrove forests are led by a matriarch. In a traditional rite of passage the chieftain is sacrificed by the next-in-line successor using a special technique. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Smart apes / Wendigos
entries.excerpt: Among Paradis primates, Gigantopithecus are enormous orangutans that eat leaves and fruit and defend themselves with two great canines; Wendigos are enormous apes with skinny but strong bodies, carnivores that hunt other primates.

entries.name: Knighteaters
entries.excerpt: Knighteaters are giant anteaters that tear up the ground with their claws and eat slime moulds and small creatures with long tongues. They are the only mammals of Paradis that do not lay eggs; they carry their young.

entries.name: Knight ants — Queen ants
entries.excerpt: Queen ants are one of the roles of the knight ants of Paradis: two per colony, making it a diarchy. Colonies also include queens, attackers, defenders, hunters, spotters, diggers and tanks (see REM-1061).

entries.name: Knight ants — Attacker ants
entries.excerpt: Attacker ants are one of the roles of the knight ants of Paradis: with a tusk-horn mouth. Colonies also include queens, attackers, defenders, hunters, spotters, diggers and tanks (see REM-1061).

entries.name: Knight ants — Defender ants
entries.excerpt: Defender ants are one of the roles of the knight ants of Paradis: with a head shield. Colonies also include queens, attackers, defenders, hunters, spotters, diggers and tanks (see REM-1061).

entries.name: Knight ants — Hunter ants
entries.excerpt: Hunter ants are one of the roles of the knight ants of Paradis: with trap-jaw mouths. Colonies also include queens, attackers, defenders, hunters, spotters, diggers and tanks (see REM-1061).

entries.name: Knight ants — Spotter ants
entries.excerpt: Spotter ants are one of the roles of the knight ants of Paradis: winged. Colonies also include queens, attackers, defenders, hunters, spotters, diggers and tanks (see REM-1061).

entries.name: Knight ants — Digger ants
entries.excerpt: Digger ants are one of the roles of the knight ants of Paradis: with strong mandibles for excavating. Colonies also include queens, attackers, defenders, hunters, spotters, diggers and tanks (see REM-1061).

entries.name: Knight ants — Tank ants
entries.excerpt: Tank ants are one of the roles of the knight ants of Paradis: with an expandable abdomen storing large quantities of liquid. Colonies also include queens, attackers, defenders, hunters, spotters, diggers and tanks (see REM-1061).

entries.name: Li'atans (leviathans)
entries.excerpt: Li'atans ("leviathan") are the most intelligent species on Paradis: colossal cetaceans 18 metres long that live about 160 years, with an extremely complex language of varied sounds. Their main prey is the titan kalamar REM-1059, and they have domesticated the

entries.excerpt: The titan kalamar is a 20-metre squid of the twilight zone, the main prey of the li'atans REM-1058. Its left eye is at least twice the diameter of the right: tubular, yellow-green, upward-facing and bulging. The lexicon glosses "titankkalamar" as a colossal sq

entries.name: Lisodålphin
entries.excerpt: The lisodålphin ("lissodolphin") was domesticated by the li'atans REM-1058, just for fun, over about 300 years.

entries.name: Multipods / Worms
entries.excerpt: Multipods are Paradis animals with segmented bodies and multiple limbs; worms are multipods that lost their legs. They include the solitaires REM-1064 and the knight ants, whose roles are queens, attackers, defenders, hunters, spotters, diggers and tanks.

entries.name: Vierpods
entries.excerpt: Vierpods are Paradis animals with four limbs.

entries.name: Quasimammals / Naked mole lizards
entries.excerpt: Quasimammals are a taxon whose definition is unfinished in the source; naked mole lizards are listed under them. The same notes say Paradis mammals are oviviparous.

entries.name: Solitaires (phronima sedentaria)
entries.excerpt: Solitaires (Phronima sedentaria) are listed among the multipods REM-1061 of Paradis.

entries.name: Haunnharis (keeper dog)
entries.excerpt: Haunnharis ("keeper dog") is a species of dog with two heads, in the Paradis lexicon. Flagged explicit through the surrounding lexicon.

entries.name: Piporesi (Sea People)
entries.excerpt: Piporesi is the Paradis lexicon word for the Sea People.

entries.name: Paradis language (Paradisian lexicon)
entries.excerpt: The Paradis language is a constructed language with subject-object-verb word order and its own lexicon (for example hele "whole", ster "star", titan "dream", tuonela "underworld"). See also REM-685.

entries.name: Eros maseuse
entries.excerpt: An eros maseuse is an erotic masseuse, a role named in the encyclopedia. Flagged explicit.

entries.name: Amanda UKnight
entries.excerpt: Amanda UKnight is half elf, half human, and a knight, listed among the warriors of Eden.

entries.name: Abanonya
entries.excerpt: Abanonya is one of three tribal chiefs who live together, with Olaurae REM-581 and Mirabanise REM-582, in an alternative list; their tribes are so close they seem one.

entries.name: Isilo ("Beast")
entries.excerpt: Isilo is another legendary warrior of Eden, called "Beast".

entries.name: Guerriera Urlante (Screaming Warrior)
entries.excerpt: A Screaming Warrior REM-555 is the rank a cadet REM-1076 reaches when judged ready. Every two cadets must have one as Master and Judge. Two years after the rank, she may make a one-day expedition in which she must kill at least one marianne REM-767.

entries.name: Tempio Sacro (Sacred Temple, Totem of Eden)
entries.excerpt: The Sacred Temple at the centre of the Black Forest REM-593 is the Totem of Eden. Per the Laws of Paradise, no one may profane, usurp or damage it; further information is in the Holy Book, accessible only to tribal chiefs. The Oracle stands around it.

entries.name: Cadette (Eden cadets)
entries.excerpt: Cadets are all newborn girls of Eden, including chiefs' daughters except the firstborn, trained in the Black Forest REM-593 for 18 years. Those judged ready become Screaming Warriors REM-1074.

entries.source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
entries.excerpt: The Triangulo de la Muerte is a group that included Melyssa Jehoel REM-1000, who died with acid in her mouth (see REM-533).
